TL;DR: Unisense 通过先将多种实体感知表示对齐到语言、再在共享 LLM 中调优模态专家，构建覆盖八种感觉模态的具身多模态模型；其 100 万样本训练集支持 12 个深度、点云、IMU、触觉、热成像、雷达、运动和嗅觉基准，并在多数任务超过通用及专门模型。

Details

Motivation: 具身系统越来越依赖多模态大语言模型的理解和推理，但其物理感知通常限于视觉和音频。扩展到更多环境感觉模态面临表示结构与统计差异大、且难与 LLM 共享的高层语义推理连接的问题。

Result: Unisense 以两阶段训练统一多种物理感知：先把感觉表示与语言对齐，建立语言可访问接口；再在共享 LLM 中调优模态专属专家。作者整理 Unisense-1M，含八种感知模态共 100 万训练样本，并在 12 个基准评估深度、点云、IMU、触觉、热成像、雷达、运动和嗅觉理解。跨异质任务，模型在多数基准上超过通用模型和专门模型。

Insight: 语言对齐接口与模态专家分工，可以在保留各感觉模态特性的同时共享高层理解和推理。摘要没有给出各基准的具体分数、资源成本或未覆盖传感器类型。

Abstract: Recent embodied systems increasingly build on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for their pretrained understanding and reasoning capabilities, but their perception of the physical world remains largely limited to basic modalities such as vision and audio. However, broadening MLLMs to more diverse sensory modalities from the physical environment is challenging: their representations are often weakly connected to the MLLM and vary substantially in structure and statistics, while their interpretation still requires shared high-level understanding and reasoning. We therefore propose Unisense, a unified embodied MLLM framework that supports diverse physical sensory modalities within a shared multimodal architecture. Unisense follows a two-stage training process: (i) aligning sensory representations with language to establish a language-accessible interface; and (ii) tuning modality-specific experts within the shared LLM to provide specialized processing for different sensory modalities. To support broad sensory learning, we curate Unisense-1M, a large-scale embodied sensory training corpus comprising 1M samples across 8 sensory modalities. We further evaluate Unisense on 12 benchmarks spanning depth, point cloud, IMU, tactile, thermal, radar, motion, and smell understanding. Across these heterogeneous sensing tasks, Unisense achieves strong performance and outperforms both generalist and specialized models on most benchmarks, demonstrating the potential of pretrained MLLMs as unified models for embodied sensory understanding.

[229] V-JEPA Hand: Simple, Accurate and Fast 3D Hand and Camera Trajectory Recovery from Egocentric Videos cs.CVPDF

Ruicheng Li, Qixiu Li, Yu Deng, Sicheng Xu, Jiaolong Yang

TL;DR: V-JEPA Hand 用单次前向视频模型联合恢复第一视角双手动作和相机自运动，并将手轨迹变换到统一世界坐标；在 ARCTIC、HOT3D 和 EgoStandard 上取得可比基线中最低的覆盖率感知 MPJPE，单张 RTX A6000 吞吐为 93.4 FPS。

Details

Motivation: 从第一视角视频恢复公制 3D 手轨迹，既要估计手部运动，也要估计相机自运动，才能把手放进一致参考坐标。传统流水线往往把手检测、手部重建、相机跟踪和轨迹优化分开处理。

Result: V-JEPA Hand 是前馈视频模型，用自监督 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器从全帧视频提取时空特征，再通过查询式预测器输出逐帧双手姿态、手是否可见及相机运动，并用预测的相机运动把手轨迹变换到共同世界坐标。模型可使用已知焦距，或在焦距缺失时自行预测；整段视频一次前向完成重建。训练采用单阶段端到端混合数据，包含多样伪标签视频和高精度 3D 标注。在 ARCTIC、HOT3D、EgoStandard 上，覆盖率感知 MPJPE 低于可比基线；世界坐标轨迹误差也低于对比 SLAM 流程。消融支持视频预训练、时间上下文和混合监督的作用，单张 RTX A6000 前向吞吐为 93.4 FPS。

Insight: 手运动和相机自运动需要联合估计后才能获得稳定世界坐标轨迹；将二者拆成独立流水线可能引入坐标误差。摘要未提供误差绝对值、伪标签规模和跨设备部署结果。

Abstract: Egocentric video supports diverse applications, including robot learning, augmented reality, and human activity understanding. Recovering metric 3D hand trajectories from such video requires estimating both hand motion and camera egomotion to express the hands in a consistent reference frame. Many existing pipelines recover hand and camera motion in separate stages, combining hand detection, hand reconstruction, camera tracking, and trajectory refinement. We present V-JEPA Hand, a simple feed-forward video model that jointly reconstructs bilateral hand motion and camera motion from egocentric clips. It uses a self-supervised V-JEPA 2.1 encoder to extract spatio-temporal features from full-frame video and a query-based predictor to decode these features into per-frame hand poses, hand presence, and camera motion. We use the predicted camera motion to express the hand trajectories in a common world frame. The model accepts known focal lengths or predicts them when unavailable. It reconstructs each clip in a single forward pass. We train both components end to end in a single stage on a mixture of diverse pseudo-labelled videos and high-precision 3D annotations. A single model achieves the lowest coverage-aware mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) among comparable baselines on ARCTIC, HOT3D, and EgoStandard. It also yields lower world-frame trajectory errors than the compared SLAM-based pipelines. Ablations support the benefits of video pretraining, temporal context, and mixed supervision. V-JEPA Hand achieves a forward-pass throughput of 93.4 FPS on a single RTX A6000. Project page: https://qft-333.github.io/V-JEPA-Hand-Page/.

[230] Mise-en-Video: Fine-Grained 3D Control for Multi-Shot Video Generation cs.CV | cs.AIPDF

Yingshuang Zou, Xiaoyu Shi, Yawen Luo, Ziang Li, Qinghe Wang

TL;DR: Mise-en-Video 允许创作者先在 3D 空间安排多镜头舞台调度，再生成对应视频；层次注意力维持叙事一致性，3D 布局条件控制每镜头空间构图，并配套构建 16 万视频及方向 3D 框数据集。

Details

Motivation: 文本到视频模型已能生成高保真单镜头，但实际叙事创作还需跨镜头一致和细粒度控制。现有多镜头生成方法虽有较强镜头间一致性，创作者仍难精确控制场面调度。

Result: Mise-en-Video（MeV）让视频创作者在 3D 空间规划多镜头场面，再生成相应视频。框架结合多层叙事一致性层次注意力与 3D 感知布局引导，提供逐镜头空间控制。为训练和评测，作者建立标准化标注流程和 16 万视频数据集，含层次化多镜头文本及方向 3D 边界框。实验显示，MeV 在视频质量、镜头间一致性和主体级可控性上持续超过强基线。

Insight: 将多镜头生成分解为可显式规划的三维场景调度，可在保持叙事连续性的同时提升创作者对单镜头布局的控制。摘要未报告具体质量指标、训练数据分布或与逐镜头人工控制成本的比较。

Abstract: Recent advances in text-to-video generation have enabled high-fidelity single-shot synthesis, yet practical storytelling creation requires multi-shot videos with both strong inter-shot consistency and fine-grained controllability. Existing multi-shot video generation approaches achieve strong consistency but still fall short in controllability. In this paper, we propose Mise-en-Video (MeV), a highly controllable multi-shot video generation framework that allows video creators to conduct staging the multi-shot in the 3D space and then generate the corresponding multi-shot video. To achieve this, our framework combines a hierarchical attention mechanism for multi-level narrative consistency with 3D-aware layout guidance for precise, per-shot spatial control. To support training and evaluation, we develop standardized annotation pipelines and construct a 160K-video dataset with hierarchical multi-shot texts and oriented 3D bounding boxes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MeV consistently outperforms strong baselines in video quality, inter-shot consistency, and subject-level controllability.

[231] What Language Adds, and at What Cost: Four Controlled Probes of Pathology Vision-Language Models cs.CV | q-bio.QMPDF

Wenhao Zhang, Zhongliang Zhou, Yi Ping, Zirui Wang, Sheng Li

TL;DR: 对病理视觉语言模型的四项受控探针显示，文本报告能在某些生存预测中提供窄范围增益，但提示词未带来可测分类精度提升，SlideChat 的问答在有无切片时准确率几乎相同，且改写问题可使 8–23% 回答翻转。

Details

Motivation: 病理 VLM 被认为可支持自然语言查询和报告草拟，但相较视觉骨干本身，语言究竟增加了多少价值尚不清楚；多数系统由开发者在自选测试集上评估，难以区分真正语言能力与数据、模型因素。

Result: 作者复用公开检查点和数据，通过一次只改变一个输入的四项探针检验语言贡献。跨 1,633 名 TCGA 患者，加入去除分期信息的冻结报告嵌入后，进展无病间期和总生存 pooled C-index 分别增加 0.019 和 0.016；恢复分期句没有额外增益。固定视觉特征和池化方式后，肺癌及肾癌亚型的零样本提示分类与监督线性探针统计上无差异。SlideChat 在带切片与不带切片时分别答对 74.82% 和 74.41% 的 SlideBench-VQA(TCGA) 项目，语言骨干单独为 43.52%；释义改写保持准确率，却使 8–23% 回答发生变化。论文认为现有证据还不足以把智能体导航和 few-shot 语言先验增益归因于语言。

Insight: 语言确有有限但狭窄的作用：报告文本可增加部分预后信号，但提示分类收益与切片问答 grounding 需独立验证。摘要建议未来评测采用控制输入的一次一变量对照；未给出四项探针之外的病理任务结论。

Abstract: Vision–language models (VLMs) promise to make computational pathology queryable and able to draft reports, but how much language adds beyond the vision backbone is unclear, because almost every system is evaluated by its developers on test sets of their own choosing. We grade published evidence by how it was produced and test four claims with controlled probes that reuse released checkpoints and public data, varying one input at a time. Report text adds prognostic signal: adding a frozen embedding of the stage-redacted report to a slide embedding raises the pooled C-index by 0.019 for progression-free interval and by 0.016 for overall survival across 1{,}633 TCGA patients, and restoring the stage statement adds nothing. Prompts add no measurable accuracy at inference: with features and pooling fixed, zero-shot classification is statistically indistinguishable from a supervised linear probe for lung and renal cancer subtyping. Slide-level question answering is barely grounded: SlideChat answers 74.82% of SlideBench-VQA(TCGA) items correctly with the slide and 74.41% without it, whereas its language backbone alone reaches 43.52%. Paraphrasing leaves accuracy unchanged but flips 8–23% of answers. Self-reported gains from agentic navigation and few-shot language priors cannot yet be attributed to language. Language thus adds real but narrow value, and we propose minimum controls that would expose these failure modes in future evaluations.

[232] State World Models: Execute the Rules, Generate the Pixels cs.CVPDF

Chan Yan Ki, Yanran Zhang, Wenzhao Zheng, Xiaofeng Wang, Zheng Zhu

TL;DR: Stateful Harness 将状态规则执行与视频像素渲染分离，以外部世界状态推进交互、由冻结视频模型呈现事件；在 50 对共享初始画面和动作但隐藏状态不同的反事实测试中，完整 harness 对两种情况都生成正确结局的比例达 92%。

Details

Motivation: 现有世界模型能从单张图像生成动作条件视频，常聚焦相机导航，但若动作结果取决于当前画面不可见的状态，单纯导航不保证遵守持续规则。

Result: Stateful Harness 在指定规则下维护演化的世界状态，以冻结视频模型渲染每个事件，并用生成片段更新下一轮状态。每轮先解析用户动作并将结果编译为指令；可编辑 3D 场景的预览片段提供空间和相机引导。作者构建 WorldState-Bench，包含 50 对反事实双生案例，每对共享初始画面和动作，但隐藏状态与正确结果不同。仅规则提示时，11 个视频后端中最佳者在 32% 案例对都产生所需结局；对 MiniMax-H3 明确指定结局后比例从 32% 升至 64%；完整 harness 在相同冻结模型下达 92%。

Insight: 隐藏状态规则应由显式状态机或 harness 执行，视频模型负责把执行结果呈现为像素；不能仅靠模型从当前画面推断不可见状态。测试集规模为 50 对案例，摘要未报告各规则类型分项或更大场景的扩展性。

Abstract: Existing world models can generate action-conditioned video from a single image. Many focus on camera movement, allowing users to explore the generated scene. However, navigation alone does not ensure that an action follows persistent rules when its outcome depends on state that is invisible in the current frame. We present Stateful Harness, a framework that separates world evolution from video rendering to support stateful and rule-governed interaction. It maintains an evolving world state under specified rules, renders each resulting event with a frozen video model, and uses the generated clip to update the world state for the next turn. At each turn, the harness resolves the action selected by the user and compiles the resulting event into an instruction, while a preview clip from an editable 3D scene provides spatial and camera guidance. To evaluate rule compliance, we build WorldState-Bench, a benchmark of 50 counterfactual twin pairs that share an initial frame and action but differ in hidden state and required outcome. Under rule-only prompting, the best of the 11 evaluated video backends produces the required endings for both cases in 32% of pairs. For MiniMax-H3, specifying the required endings raises this rate from 32% to 64%, while the full harness reaches 92% with the same frozen model. These results support separating rule execution from video rendering for world interactions with hidden state.

[233] PICA-WAM: Visual Perturbation Invariance via Cross-Appearance Self-Alignment in World Action Models cs.CV | cs.ROPDF

Yude Zou, Yifei Yao, Guanbo Jiao, Jianming Ma, Guanjie Zheng

TL;DR: PICA-WAM 通过跨外观自对齐，让在线世界动作模型对增强后的视觉扰动保持动作表征不变：EMA 教师处理原始观察，在线模型将扰动观察的浅层动作表征对齐到教师深层目标；在四种 WAM 和仿真、真实机器人评测中提高鲁棒性。

Details

Motivation: 世界动作模型同时预测未来视频并生成动作，但仍可能对与任务无关的外观变化敏感。视频预测倾向保留外观信息，动作生成却未显式要求忽略这些变化；数据增强虽能展示扰动，却不强制原图与扰动图产生一致动作表征。

Result: PICA-WAM 将扰动不变性设计为辅助的跨外观自监督对齐任务。指数移动平均教师处理名义原始观察，输出深层目标表示；在线 WAM 处理受扰观察，并通过轻量投影头将较浅层动作表征对齐至该目标。四种强 WAM 在 RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO-Plus、EBench 和真实机器人上评测，方法持续提高视觉扰动下鲁棒性、保持仿真名义表现并提高真实机器人成功率。逐层成对诊断还显示，视觉特征对无关外观更不敏感，其变化向动作传播的程度降低。

Insight: 只增加外观增强不够，需显式要求原始与扰动输入产生相容的动作表示；跨层对齐可在保留视频建模能力同时强化策略对任务无关外观变化的不变性。摘要未报告各基准提升值或扰动类别分项。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly predict future video and generate actions, yet remain sensitive to task-irrelevant visual perturbations, i.e., changes in visual appearance that should not affect robot behavior. We identify a gap in conventional WAM training: video prediction encourages representations to preserve appearance information, while action generation does not explicitly enforce invariance to task-irrelevant appearance. Data augmentation exposes WAMs to such perturbations but does not require perturbed and nominal observations to produce consistent action representations, and alignment with external pretrained features does not guarantee the desired invariance. To address this gap, we propose PICA-WAM, a self-supervised training framework that casts perturbation invariance as an auxiliary cross-appearance self-alignment task for WAMs. An exponential-moving-average (EMA) teacher processes the nominal observation to provide a deeper-layer target, while the online WAM processes a perturbed observation and aligns its shallower-layer action representation to this target through a lightweight projection head. Across four strong WAMs evaluated on RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO-Plus, EBench, and a real robot, PICA-WAM consistently improves robustness under visual perturbations, preserves nominal performance in simulation, and raises the real robot success rate. PICA-WAM further reduces the sensitivity of video features to task-irrelevant appearance and its propagation into actions, as shown by paired layer-wise diagnostics. Code: https://github.com/YudeZou/PICA-WAM-release

[234] SpecKCast: Spectral Kalman Forecasting for Diffusion Acceleration cs.CVPDF

Javad Rajabi, Hakki Can Karaimer, David B. Lindell, Babak Taati, Michael S. Brown

TL;DR: SpecKCast 在频域预测扩散模型特征，用按频带噪声时间坐标运行的轻量 Kalman 滤波器跟踪每个 DCT 系数及变化率，并在预测不确定度超过阈值时才调用 Transformer；多个图像和视频模型上最高加速 6 倍，额外内存低于 0.05 GiB。

Details

Motivation: 扩散 Transformer 需要在多步去噪中反复前向计算。缓存可复用特征，预测方法则外推被跳过步骤的特征；但现有方法均匀外推所有特征，忽略不同空间频率在不同去噪阶段变化速度不同，以及去噪时间步并非均匀进展，导致跳步增多时预测误差扩大。

Result: SpecKCast 是免训练频域预测方法，对模型输出做二维离散余弦变换，并沿依据噪声调度构造的频带专属时间坐标，用轻量 Kalman 滤波器追踪每个系数的取值和变化率。只有当滤波器预测不确定性超过阈值时才执行 Transformer 计算。在 FLUX.1-dev、Qwen-Image、Wan2.1-14B 和 HunyuanVideo 上，SpecKCast 相较缓存和预测基线取得更好的加速—保真权衡，最高达到 6 倍加速，额外内存少于 0.05 GiB。

Insight: 去噪不同频带的特征变化速度与阶段不同，按噪声时间坐标逐频带预测比统一时间间隔外推更适合控制跳步误差。摘要未提供各模型对应的加速与保真数值。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve high-fidelity image and video generation, but they suffer from substantial inference costs due to repeated transformer evaluations across many denoising steps. Feature caching reduces this cost by reusing features across denoising steps. Recent forecasting methods extend this idea by extrapolating features to skipped steps instead of reusing them. However, existing forecasting methods extrapolate the features they predict uniformly, even though the spatial-frequency components of these features change most at different stages of denoising. They also overlook that denoising progresses nonuniformly, so equal step intervals can correspond to very different amounts of change. These mismatches amplify forecast errors as more steps are skipped, limiting the achievable acceleration. We propose SpecKCast, a training-free method that forecasts the model output in the frequency domain. SpecKCast applies a 2D discrete cosine transform (DCT) to the output and tracks each coefficient with a lightweight Kalman filter along a band-specific time coordinate derived from the noise schedule. The filter tracks each coefficient’s value and rate of change, and the transformer is evaluated only when the filter’s forecast uncertainty exceeds a threshold. Experiments on FLUX.1-dev, Qwen-Image, Wan2.1-14B, and HunyuanVideo show that SpecKCast achieves a better trade-off between acceleration and fidelity than existing caching and forecasting methods, reaching up to 6x speedup with less than 0.05 GiB of additional memory.

[235] GenOlympiad: Benchmarking Frontier Image Models at Their Capability Boundaries cs.CVPDF

Xi Hu, Martin Bell, Liang Zheng

TL;DR: GenOlympiad 用九类高难提示压力测试前沿文生图模型，并以可视化可核验的提示和自动分解评分框架检查能力边界；评测 20 多个模型后，最佳 Nano Banana Pro 严格得分仅 23.9/100。

Details

Motivation: 文生图模型已能生成高质量图像，但仍需明确前沿模型在哪些能力上失效。主观风格评价不易自动核实，论文选择数量、深度推理、物理一致性和复杂规则等可视觉验证的能力构造压力测试。

Result: GenOlympiad 包含九个能力维度的高难提示，设计使提示对齐可由图像直接验证，例如计数，而非依赖风格偏好。配套自动评估框架将提示拆为容易和困难的问题，并为多数难题提供证据依据以提高评分准确性。作者评测 20 多个强文生图模型；最佳模型 Nano Banana Pro 严格得分为 100 分中的 23.9。代码模型 GPT-6 Astra 的提示对齐分数更高，但图像观感不如最佳文生图模型。论文还分析模型演进、与 Elo 排名的一致性和 grounding 评估的效果。

Insight: 高保真并不意味着模型能遵守复杂、物理合理或数量精确的提示；用视觉可验证条件和困难项证据评分能暴露能力边界。摘要未提供九个维度分项或各模型完整排名。

Abstract: Text-to-image models have made tremendous progress and can produce high-quality images. However, a question which would be asked in any other discipline is where the frontier models fall short. We introduce GenOlympiad, a benchmark which provides the most challenging text prompts from nine capability axes for stress-testing frontier text-to-image models. The assessed capabilities include generating large quantities, performing deep reasoning, ensuring hard physical consistency, following complex rules and so on. The prompts are designed such that prompt alignment is visually verifiable (e.g., counting) instead of relying on subjectiveness (e.g., style). Based on this, we develop an automated evaluation framework which decomposes the prompt into easy and hard questions, and for most hard questions, draws help lines to ground evidence for accurate grading. We evaluate 20+ strong text-to-image models, including Nano Banana Pro, GPT-Image-2.5, Seedream-5.0 and so on. We report that even the best-performing T2I model (Nano Banana Pro) only achieves a strict score of 23.9 out of 100 and that coding models such as GPT-6 Astra have higher prompt alignment scores (but not as visually pleasing). We also derive insights in model evolution, alignment with Elo scores, and effectiveness of our grounding-based evaluation protocol. Code is available at https://github.com/GenOlympiad/GenOlympiad and the project page is at https://genolympiad.github.io/

[236] Manga2Animate: An Agentic Framework for Faithful Manga Animation with Script and Storyboard Planning cs.CVPDF

Sheng-Wei Zhang, Hsi-An Chen, Yan-Ting Liou, Chih-Hsuan Chen, Shih-Chen Tseng

TL;DR: Manga2Animate 以动画脚本和视觉分镜作为两个中间表示，并让生成代理与对照源漫画分格的审阅代理协作迭代；实验和用户研究显示，生成动画在源漫画忠实度与镜头间一致性上超过所比较先进方法。

Details

Motivation: 把现有漫画改编为连贯动画需要忠实保留源故事、人物和画风。只依据文字的现有方法会丢失图像内容，直接将漫画页送入视频模型则可能误解分格结构并生成错误剧情。

Result: Manga2Animate 采用多智能体框架，使生成每个阶段都以源漫画为依据，并把任务分成动画脚本和视觉分镜两个中间表示。每种表示由创作者代理生成，再由配对审阅代理对照漫画面板检查；方法结合表示专属选择和双层反馈，逐步细化两种表示后才合成最终动画。广泛实验和用户研究显示，该框架生成的动画较先进方法更忠实于原漫画，镜头间也更一致。

Insight: 在最终视频生成前显式规划脚本和分镜，并在每步回看源漫画，可减少模型误读漫画版式和剧情结构。摘要未给出具体用户研究规模、量化指标或生成成本。

Abstract: Adapting existing manga into coherent animation that stays faithful to the source is a valuable yet challenging task. Existing methods either access the manga mainly through text, losing its characters and art style, or feed manga pages directly into video generation models, which misinterpret the manga’s structure and produce incorrect storylines. In this paper, we propose Manga2Animate, a multi-agent framework that grounds every stage of generation in the source manga. We decompose the task into two intermediate representations, an animation script and a visual storyboard. Each representation is produced by a creator agent and reviewed against the source panels by a paired reviewer agent. We tailor representation-specific selection and dual-level feedback to progressively refine both before synthesizing the final animation. Extensive experiments and a user study demonstrate that Manga2Animate produces animations more faithful to the source manga and more consistent across shots than state-of-the-art approaches. Project page: https://annchenn.github.io/Manga2Animate/

[237] InfiniDream: Open-Ended Photorealistic 3D Worlds Through Procedural Generation cs.CVPDF

Yi-Chuan Huang, Hao-Jen Chien, Zheng-Hui Huang, Yu-Lun Liu, Kaipeng Zhang

TL;DR: InfiniDream 用 VLM 驱动开放式程序化 3D 世界生成：符号约束资产模块调用现有程序算法创造可编辑且支持随机种子的写实资产，再通过语义场景规划和确定性视锥网格布置生成大型场景；100 个物体及 20 个场景任务的四项感知指标均改善。

Details

Motivation: 程序化生成比静态网格更可控、易编辑且多样，但 VLM 代码生成常只得到简单 3D 资产；复杂写实程序系统需大量人工开发。既有 VLM 引导方法又受预定义工厂和 API 限制，难以创造新的资产类型。

Result: InfiniDream 是 VLM 驱动的开放式程序化世界生成框架。Symbolically Constrained Asset Generation 利用现有程序算法生成新颖写实资产，同时保留编辑性和基于随机种子的多样性；端到端文本到世界流程将语义场景规划与确定性视锥引导网格布置结合，实现大规模场景中精确物体放置、程序化填充和动画。在 100 个物体与 20 个场景生成任务上的评估显示，四项感知指标均有改善；多样性分析、消融和人类偏好结果进一步支持该方法。

Insight: 结合可复用程序算法与符号约束，可能突破固定资产工厂的开放性限制，同时保留生成场景的编辑能力。摘要未说明四项指标名称、改善幅度或与人工程序建模的成本差别。

Abstract: Procedural generation plays a key role in synthetic data creation and game development, offering greater controllability, editability, and diversity than static mesh representations. However, VLM-based code generation often produces relatively simple 3D assets, while sophisticated photorealistic procedural systems require extensive manual development. Existing VLM-guided procedural methods remain largely constrained by predefined factories and APIs, limiting their ability to create novel asset types. We introduce InfiniDream, a VLM-driven framework for open-ended procedural 3D world generation. First, we propose Symbolically Constrained Asset Generation, which leverages existing procedural algorithms to create novel, photorealistic assets while preserving editability and seed-based diversity. Second, we develop an end-to-end text-to-world pipeline that combines semantic scene planning with Deterministic Frustum-Guided Grid Placement to construct large-scale 3D worlds with precise object placement, procedural population, and animation. Extensive evaluations on 100 object and 20 scene generation tasks demonstrate improvements across four perceptual metrics. Diversity analysis, ablation studies, and human preference evaluations further validate the effectiveness of our framework. Project page: https://yichuanh.github.io/infinidream-page/

[238] Ropedia W0: Scaling Loco-Manipulation World Models across Embodiments with Human Experience cs.CV | cs.ROPDF

Tianqi Liu, Hanfei Zhao, Qifeng Liang, Hui En Pang, Jiarui Xu

TL;DR: Ropedia W0 是跨人类与多种机器人形态的第一视角运动—操作世界基础模型，以 10,000 小时人类和 3,000 小时机器人数据训练，并用统一骨骼表示动作；在五个跨形态基准和留出人类视频上达到先进表现，蒸馏后可实时生成分钟级 rollout。

Details

Motivation: 世界模型可让具身智能体预测动作后果，但要在不同形态间联合建模行走和操作，面临动作空间异质、跨模态监督有限的问题。

Result: Ropedia W0 构建含 10,000 小时第一视角人类数据和 3,000 小时机器人数据的 Xp-Data，配有统一多模态标注与质量控制。统一运动学表示以相机位姿编码行走，以投影骨架编码操作；机器人骨架结合形态专属正向运动学和大量人工关键点标注校正。作者还建立基于高质量灵巧人形远程操作数据的长时基准 Xp-Teleop。评估涵盖 DreamDojo、Ψ0、ω-HOME、Xp-Teleop、AgiBot 五个跨形态基准和留出人类第一视角视频，涵盖零样本、少样本及全数据后训练，模型均达先进结果；扩大人类预训练数据可同时改善人类和机器人评估。蒸馏后支持实时、分钟级 rollout 和 VR 交互。

Insight: 人类第一视角经验可与机器人轨迹共享统一运动学表示，为跨形态预测和控制提供大规模监督；人类数据扩展也改善机器人任务。摘要未列五个基准的具体分数或各数据来源贡献。

Abstract: World models enable embodied agents to anticipate action consequences, yet jointly modeling locomotion and manipulation across diverse embodiments remains challenging due to heterogeneous action spaces and limited multimodal supervision. We present Ropedia W0, the first egocentric loco-manipulation world foundation model spanning humans and robots with diverse embodiments. We curate Xp-Data, comprising 10k hours of egocentric human data and 3k hours of robot data with unified multimodal annotations and systematic quality control. A unified kinematic representation encodes locomotion through camera poses and manipulation through projected skeletons, with robot skeletons combining embodiment-specific forward kinematics with extensive manual keypoint annotation and correction. We also introduce Xp-Teleop, a long-horizon loco-manipulation benchmark based on high-quality dexterous humanoid teleoperation data. Evaluations demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across five cross-embodiment benchmarks (DreamDojo, $Ψ_0$, $ω$-HOME, Xp-Teleop, and AgiBot) and on held-out human egocentric video, from zero-shot inference to few-shot and full-data post-training. Scaling human pre-training data improves performance on both human and robot evaluations. After distillation, our model supports real-time, minute-long rollouts, enabling live VR interaction. Applications in policy evaluation, model-based planning, and world-action modeling further demonstrate the model’s utility for embodied decision-making.

[239] Reinforcement Learning with Visually Attributable On-Policy Self-Distillation cs.CV | cs.AIPDF

Shiao Xie, Siyu Chen, Jianwei Lv, Xiandong Li, Yujin Wang

TL;DR: VAG 用验证器优势作优化锚点，并比较特权教师在有视觉证据与证据退化视图下的修正方向，只保留与视觉证据一致的 on-policy 自蒸馏更新；六个视觉推理基准上持续超过 GRPO 和普通 OPSD，达到论文报告的平均最佳水平。

Details

Motivation: 带可验证奖励的多模态强化学习能提供可靠任务级监督，但难定位视觉推理错误；特权教师可给出密集 token 修正，然而修正可能混入语言先验、回答风格或教师视图差异，而不是真正由视觉证据支持。

Result: 论文提出视觉可归因 on-policy 自蒸馏范式，以任务级 RLVR 结合基于视觉证据的特权 token 修正，并将无法稳定归因到证据的修正定义为 privileged-correction contamination。实例化方法 Visual-Attribution Gating（VAG）以验证器导出的优势作为优化锚点，将教师在证据充分与证据退化视图中的修正进行对比，只接纳方向上受视觉差异支持的更新，抑制不一致残差。六个视觉推理基准实验显示，VAG 一贯超过 GRPO 与 OPSD 方法，并达到论文报告的新平均最佳性能。

Insight: 教师提供密集监督并不保证它由图像证据驱动；通过证据充分/退化对照验证修正方向，可减少视觉推理中的非视觉偏差。摘要未给出各基准准确率、增幅或门控阈值。

Abstract: Multimodal reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides reliable task-level supervision, yet offers limited guidance for localizing errors in visual reasoning. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) complements this supervision with dense token-level corrections from a privileged teacher equipped with an evidence-centered visual view. However, the resulting corrections may conflate visual evidence with non-visual shifts induced by linguistic priors, response style, or the privileged view itself. We formalize this phenomenon as privileged-correction contamination: a token-level correction is contaminated when its update direction cannot be consistently attributed to the privileged visual evidence. Directly distilling contaminated corrections may therefore reinforce erroneous token-level updates. To address this issue, we propose reinforcement learning with visually attributable on-policy self-distillation, an evidence-consistent paradigm that augments task-level RLVR supervision with privileged token-level corrections grounded in visual evidence. We instantiate this paradigm with Visual-Attribution Gating (VAG), which uses the verifier-derived advantage as the optimization anchor and validates each privileged correction against the contrast between evidence-present and evidence-degraded teacher views. By admitting only corrections directionally supported by this visual contrast, VAG preserves visually grounded guidance while suppressing inconsistent residuals. Experiments across six visual reasoning benchmarks show that VAG consistently outperforms GRPO and OPSD methods, establishing new state-of-the-art average performance.

[240] VideoMaMa++: Temporally Consistent Video Matting via Preserve-and-Refine Token cs.CVPDF

Sangbeom Lim, Seoung Wug Oh, Heeji Yoon, Seungryong Kim, Joon-Young Lee

TL;DR: VideoMaMa++ 将 RGB 和粗掩码分成两个 token 流并用时空自注意力融合，再以 preserve/refine 可学习 token 跨短块传递已生成 matte；无需额外训练即可减少长视频分块边界闪烁，并在基准及真实长片段上提升细节和时间一致性。

Details

Motivation: 扩散式视频抠图依赖大规模预训练视频先验，合成数据上可零样本泛化，但计算量使推理只能处理 6–24 帧短块。常见方法独立处理每个块、只依赖粗掩码引导，导致块边界处边缘闪烁和透明度不连续。

Result: 该框架将 RGB 与掩码条件编码为独立 token 流，并通过完整时空自注意力交互，使模型能自适应融合细节纹理与粗略布局，而不使用固定通道融合。可学习的 preserve 和 refine token 提供逐帧条件接口，支持滑动窗口推理：已生成 matte 跨块传播以保持局部时间一致性，每块再共享全局参考锚点以避免长序列误差累积，无需额外训练。在标准视频抠图基准和真实长视频上，方法较既有扩散方法提升细节精度与时间一致性，并能维持长视频块边界的一致性。

Insight: 长视频分块处理需要显式在块间传递抠图状态，同时用全局参考防止局部误差累积；仅逐块独立推理难保持透明边界稳定。摘要未报告基准数值或滑窗推理额外成本。

Abstract: Diffusion-based video matting has recently emerged as a leading approach, leveraging video diffusion priors from internet-scale pretraining to achieve strong zero-shot generalization from limited synthetic data. However, the heavy compute of these diffusion backbones limits inference to a short chunk of just 6 to 24 frames, so even ordinary videos span multiple chunks. Because each chunk is matted independently from coarse mask guidance, existing methods fail to maintain consistency across chunk boundaries, producing flickering edges and discontinuous transparency. We address this with a mask-guided diffusion-matting framework built on two ideas. The RGB and mask conditioning are represented as separate token streams that interact through full spatio-temporal self-attention, letting the model adaptively combine fine RGB texture with coarse mask layout rather than committing to a fixed channel-wise fusion. On top of this, we propose a novel pair of learnable embeddings, the preserve token and the refine token, that act as a per-frame conditioning interface and enable a sliding-window inference scheme in which already-generated mattes are propagated across chunk boundaries for local temporal consistency, complemented by a globally shared reference anchor at every chunk to prevent error accumulation in long sequences without any additional training. Across standard video matting benchmarks and in-the-wild long footage, our framework outperforms prior diffusion-based methods in both fine-detail accuracy and temporal consistency, and uniquely maintains consistency across chunk boundaries on long videos.

[241] Can It Actually Work? Synthesizing Functional CAD Mechanisms cs.CV | cs.CL | cs.GRPDF

Wenqian Zhang, Yangyi Huang, Zigeng Xu, Weiyang Liu, Zhen Liu

TL;DR: FunCAD-Harness 将抽象物理功能要求转成针对具体候选 CAD 机构的模拟测试，并据反馈指导设计修订；FunCADBench 覆盖 46 个含相互依赖、多步操作的机构家族，前沿 LLM 智能体实验显示功能成功率超过标准仿真增强基线。

Details

Motivation: LLM 智能体能生成视觉上合理的 CAD 装配，却常无法实现预期物理功能。候选机构可能用完全不同部件、控制方式和操作顺序实现同一功能，因此验证抽象需求并不简单。

Result: FunCAD-Harness 将抽象功能要求翻译成候选专属的物理测试，再用模拟反馈指导设计迭代。作者构建 FunCADBench，涵盖 46 个机构家族及相互依赖、多步操作。前沿 LLM 智能体实验显示，FunCAD-Harness 能发现视觉检查难以察觉的机械故障，功能成功率显著高于标准仿真增强基线。

Insight: CAD 评估不能只检查装配外观或固定组件结构，应将用户功能要求转成每个候选机构可执行的物理测试。摘要未给出成功率数值、仿真精度或与人工机械工程设计的对比。

Abstract: While LLM agents can generate visually plausible CAD assemblies, these designs often fail to fulfill their intended physical functions. We study functional CAD design, a setting where agents interpret underspecified requests to construct and iteratively revise mechanisms that satisfy functional requirements in physical simulation. Verifying these requirements is nontrivial: different candidate mechanisms may realize the same function through entirely different components, controls, and operating sequences. To bridge this gap, we propose FunCAD-Harness, a framework that translates abstract requirements into candidate-specific physical tests and uses simulation feedback to guide design revisions. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce FunCADBench, a benchmark spanning 46 mechanism families with interdependent and multi-step operations. Experiments across frontier LLM agents show that FunCAD-Harness exposes subtle mechanical failures invisible to visual inspection, substantially improving functional success rates over standard simulation-augmented baselines. Ultimately, our work marks a step toward CAD agents capable of translating human intent into working mechanisms.

[242] Beyond Explicit Intent: Discovering and Shaping Artistic Intent through Human-AI Co-Creation cs.AI | cs.CV | cs.HCPDF

Renye Yan, Jialun Zhong, Jikang Cheng, Yi Gao, Yanzeng Li

TL;DR: 论文提出通过扩大生成探索、让艺术家比较并挑选视觉结果来发现原本模糊或未表达的创作意图，再把对生成轨迹的策展偏好以不同强度用于强化学习，形成持续探索—识别—塑造循环；三项用户研究分别考察偏好发现、个性化对齐和模糊意图外化。

Details

Motivation: 生成式 AI 正成为艺术创作媒介，但现有交互通常假定创作者事先能明确表达意图并用提示词准确传达。真实艺术意图可能模糊、潜在，或只有看到具体视觉可能性后才被识别。

Result: 该人机共创范式先扩大模型探索空间，以多样视觉结果让艺术家通过观察、比较和选择发现未曾言明的偏好；随后把艺术家的策展判断融入强化学习，根据对不同生成轨迹的偏好分配不同学习强度，强化更被认可的方向，使模型逐渐适应个人审美。流程形成“探索—识别—塑造—再探索”的循环，让意图逐步被发现、外化并塑造。三项用户研究分别考察潜在偏好发现、个性化偏好对齐，以及难以言说的创作意图外化。

Insight: 创作提示未必能在生成前完整表达意图；让用户先比较具体结果，再把选择反馈给模型，能把生成过程变成意图探索工具。摘要未报告用户研究人数、偏好对齐效果数值或长期创作结果。

Abstract: Generative AI is becoming an important medium for artistic creation, yet existing interactions often assume that creators can specify intentions in advance and accurately communicate them through text prompts. Artistic intentions, however, may be vague, latent, or recognizable only after seeing concrete visual possibilities. We propose a human-AI co-creation paradigm beyond explicit intent expression. By expanding model exploration, we expose artists to diverse visual possibilities, allowing them to identify previously unarticulated preferences through observation, comparison, and selection. We then integrate artists’ curatorial judgments into reinforcement learning, assigning different learning strengths based on preferences over generation trajectories, so recognized directions are more strongly reinforced and the model gradually adapts to individual aesthetics. This creates a continuous “explore-identify-shape-re-explore” loop in which artistic intent is progressively discovered, externalized, and shaped. Through three user studies, we examine latent-preference discovery, personalized preference alignment, and the externalization of vague, difficult-to-express creative intentions.

[243] LogicVal:A Logic-Formalized Benchmark for Constraint Satisfaction in Text-to-Image Generation cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.LOPDF

Savitha Sam Abraham, Marjan Alirezaie, Hossein Rahnama

TL;DR: LogicVal 将文生图评测表述为逻辑约束满足问题，并结合神经视觉检测与逻辑推理判断生成图像是否符合提示；实验揭示多对象、多约束组合远难于单对象属性，LogicVal 在 CLEVR 上与人类判断的 ROC-AUC 为 0.88–0.98。

Details

Motivation: 文生图模型虽已能生成高保真图像，但属性绑定、计数、空间和常识推理等能力需要独立评估。已有基准通常从单项能力设计，论文提出把对象、属性、关系及其逻辑条件统一形式化，以衡量图像是否满足完整提示约束。

Result: LogicVal 将基准对象、属性、关系和约束写成逻辑规格，并用神经视觉检测加逻辑推理评估生成图像。作者评估四种先进文生图模型、九类从单对象属性到含全称、存在、计数及蕴含关系的多对象约束。表现最佳的模型在单对象类别准确率为 98%，复杂条件多对象关系仅 53%；组合泛化中，单约束提示准确率 84%，多约束同时满足时降至 20%；不可满足约束识别率仅 23%。LogicVal 在 CLEVR 上的 ROC-AUC 为 0.88–0.98，与人类判断较一致。

Insight: 单项属性生成成功不代表模型能组合多个对象关系或识别逻辑上不可满足的提示；评测应显式描述约束并单独考察复杂组合。CLEVR 上与人类判断一致并不自动证明其覆盖真实图像场景，摘要未报告其他视觉数据集结果。

Abstract: Text-to-Image (T2I) generative models have made significant progress in producing high-fidelity images from natural-language prompts. Alongside this progress, numerous benchmarks have been developed to evaluate capabilities such as attribute binding, numeracy, spatial reasoning, and commonsense reasoning. In this work, we propose a new perspective on T2I evaluation by casting it as a constraint-satisfaction problem. We introduce a logical framework that formally specifies the benchmark domain, including objects, attributes, and relations, alongside the constraints that generated images must satisfy. We evaluated four state-of-the-art T2I models across 9 classes of constraints ranging from a single-object-attribute to multi-object relationships constraints involving logical operators ($\forall, \exists, count, \rightarrow$). Our results reveal a substantial gap between single-object and complex conditional multi-object relationship constraint classes, with the best-performing model achieving 98% accuracy on the former and just 53% on the latter. We assess compositional generalisation, finding that the best-performing model`s accuracy drops from 84% on single-constraint prompts to 20% when satisfying multiple constraints simultaneously. Identifying unsatisfiable constraints is also challenging, with the best model correctly recognizing only 23% of such prompts. Building on this framework, we introduce \textbf{LogicVal}, an evaluation methodology that combines neural visual detection with logical reasoning to assess constraint satisfaction in generated images. On CLEVR, LogicVal achieves ROC-AUC scores ranging from 0.88 to 0.98, indicating strong alignment with human judgments. These findings underscore the value of logic-based evaluation for characterizing T2I model capabilities and limitations.

[244] Cache2LoRA: Understanding and Improving Context Internalization cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.IRPDF

Yi Fang, Gaurav Srivastava, Zhenyu Bi, Sirui Ding, Xuan Wang

TL;DR: Cache2LoRA 先从可复用的冻结文档缓存中按查询聚合证据，再生成 LoRA 更新；在 17 项任务上宏平均 F1 为 0.663，接近完整上下文 ICL 的 0.671，并在 32K 文档条件下取得其 5.9 倍解码吞吐。

Details

Motivation: Context-to-LoRA 方法将文档编码为低秩参数更新，使模型回答时不必把原文放入解码上下文，但事实保留、来源区分以及按不同指令组织回答的可靠性仍不清楚。论文通过控制诊断发现竞争来源会影响答案，事实恢复也不等于遵循回答指令。

Result: Cache2LoRA 针对每个查询，从可复用的冻结文档缓存中聚合证据后生成 LoRA 更新；可训练编码只处理查询和记忆 token 后缀，并以多风格监督同时训练证据保留和答案表达。作者在 17 项任务上评估，宏平均 F1 为 0.663，接近完整上下文 in-context learning 的 0.671。对 32K 文档、256 token 输出、batch size 16，解码吞吐为完整上下文 ICL 的 5.9 倍。在相同记忆大小下，遇到长且多样的中间文本时，生成的 LoRA 比 learned-KV 变体更可靠地保留答题准确率；与保留文档 KV 组合时，混合 F1 和 EM 更高。

Insight: 生成参数更新前按问题从共享缓存中筛证据，可以同时减少长上下文解码负担并改善事实与回答风格适配。吞吐结果对应所列文档长度、输出长度和 batch 设置；摘要未说明其他资源成本或在线构建 LoRA 的延迟。

Abstract: Context-to-LoRA methods encode documents as low-rank parameter updates, allowing language models to answer without retaining the source text in their decoding context. How reliably do these updates preserve facts and support their use under different instructions? Controlled diagnosis of existing context-to-LoRA methods separates fact discrimination, target retention, and response adaptation. Competing sources influence answers, while target-only construction and memory-state optimization improve recovery at fixed update size. Recovering facts also does not ensure that answers follow response instructions. We introduce Cache2LoRA, which uses each query to aggregate evidence from a reusable frozen document cache before generating LoRA updates. Trainable encoding operates only on the query and memory-token suffix, and multi-style supervision teaches both evidence preservation and answer expression. Across 17 tasks, Cache2LoRA improves on existing context-to-LoRA methods and achieves macro F1 of 0.663, approaching full-context in-context learning at 0.671. For 32K documents and 256-token outputs at batch size 16, its decoding throughput is 5.9$\times$ that of full-context ICL. At matched memory size, generated LoRA preserves answer accuracy more reliably than the learned-KV variant under long, diverse intervening text and combines more effectively with retained document KV, yielding higher hybrid F1 and EM.

Details

Motivation: 多模态信息可以通过联合预训练编码器、下游融合独立编码器，或在推理时让语言模型作为智能体整合。论文希望厘清不同任务和标注预算下何时适合哪种范式，而非假设单一架构普遍占优。

Insight: 多模态范式的相对优势受任务形式、标注预算和单模态表示质量共同影响；任务诊断可以在训练候选融合模型前帮助选择流程。结果来自所测试的 16 组数据集和路由方案，不能据此断言对所有新任务均能正确选型。

Abstract: Jointly pretrained multimodal encoders are a common way to combine modalities, while alternatives integrate their information during downstream training or inference. When does each approach win? We compare three paradigms, instantiated with public checkpoints, across 16 paired datasets in five domains and multiple training-label budgets. JOINT trains a fusion head on frozen, jointly pretrained encoders. DECOUPLED trains a fusion head on frozen, independently pretrained encoders. AGENT gives a frozen LLM task instructions, labelled examples, available sample text, and supervised unimodal readouts. No paradigm dominates the complete 144 dataset-budget combinations: DECOUPLED wins 54, JOINT 44, and AGENT 46 by mean utility. ScienceQA, MELD, and MetMeme shift from AGENT to fusion as supervision increases. Between the fusion paradigms, JOINT leads on four of five QA datasets across all evaluated budgets, while higher unimodal 5-NN accuracy is associated with a relative shift toward DECOUPLED across eight classification datasets (Spearman $ρ=-0.67$). We test whether representation and task diagnostics predict these preferences on held-out datasets before fitting their candidate systems. A two-step cascade combines these diagnostics with task and budget metadata to select AGENT or fusion, then JOINT or DECOUPLED. Under leave-one-group-out evaluation, it selects the winner in 71.4% of cells versus 54.2% for metadata-only routing, with mean relative regret 0.028 versus 0.057. Using geometry, supervised representation diagnostics, and text-label matching together yields higher accuracy and lower regret than using any one of these sources with metadata. These results connect paradigm preferences to supervision budget, task format, and unimodal 5-NN accuracy. Target-task diagnostics thus support selecting among the three paradigms before candidate fitting.

Insight: 环境交互可把模型自己的动作尝试转化为逆动力学训练信号，使视频规划能力提升不必伴随收集大量专家动作或设计奖励。离线钻石结果仍使用专家动作标签，和在线纯自改进设置不同。

Abstract: Video generative models are an emerging tool for embodied agents: they can serve as scalable visual planners, generating videos that depict how to complete previously unseen tasks. However, executing these plans typically requires a video-to-action or “inverse dynamics” model trained on large, human-collected video-action datasets, severely limiting scalability. We introduce Mirror, a self-supervised approach that learns video-to-action mappings through environment interactions, without prior action data or hand-crafted rewards. Mirror learns by attempting to follow a visual plan by executing its best guess of the underlying actions in the environment. Mirror then trains on the resulting video-action pairs, incrementally self-improving and following the visual planner more closely. Across Atari, OGBench, and DeepMind Control, Mirror outperforms leading learning-from-observation methods with learned video plans, and achieves near-expert performance with oracle plans. On Minecraft BASALT, it outperforms methods with access to expert actions or hand-engineered task knowledge. In Minecraft survival, it is the first method to acquire an iron pickaxe through self-improvement alone, without rewards or expert action labels. In the offline setting, with expert action labels but no environment interaction, it sets a new state of the art in obtaining diamonds. Our results suggest that advances in video models can translate into increasingly capable agents without a corresponding need for hand-crafted rewards or large collections of expert action data.

Motivation: Text-to-SQL 系统通常假定自然语言查询只有一个正确 SQL，但真实问题可能存在多种合理解释并产生不同结果。歧义若未识别，系统直接给单一 SQL 会把不确定意图伪装成确定答案；获取完整数据库供模型阅读在实际部署中也可能不可行。

Result: Adversarial Intent Resolution（AIR）无需任务专属训练，先构造竞争意图解释，通过执行 SQL 验证它们是否真的产生不同结果，再依据观察到的数据差异生成有针对性的澄清问题。在 AMBROSIA 的 schema-only 设置（不暴露完整数据库）下，AIR 在所有指标上超过强化学习方法 IntentRL，例如 F1 为 0.679 对 0.618；缺少完整数据库时，AIR 性能仅下降约 7%，IntentRL 下降约 20%。在歧义来自 schema 设计而非自然语言结构的 AmbiQT 上，AIR 在两种上下文设置下都获得更高 F1，且未针对基准适配。

Abstract: Text-to-SQL systems typically assume a one-to-one mapping between natural-language queries and correct SQL translations. In practice, however, many queries are inherently ambiguous, admitting multiple valid interpretations that yield distinct outputs. We introduce Adversarial Intent Resolution (AIR), a multi-agent framework that actively probes and resolves such ambiguity without any task-specific training. AIR first constructs competing interpretations, verifies through SQL execution that they produce genuinely different results, and generates targeted clarification questions grounded in the observed data differences. Evaluating on leading benchmarks for ambiguous questions, AIR demonstrates strong performance, efficiency, and robust cross-benchmark transferability. On the AMBROSIA benchmark under schema-only context, a realistic production setting where exposing the full database is infeasible, AIR outperforms IntentRL, the state-of-the-art reinforcement learning model, across all metrics (e.g., F1 0.679 vs. 0.618). Crucially, AIR exhibits only ~7% performance degradation without the full database, compared to ~20% for IntentRL. On the AmbiQT benchmark, where ambiguity arises from schema design rather than linguistic structure, AIR achieves higher F1 under both context settings without any benchmark-specific adaptation.

Details

Motivation: 多模态训练中的模态不平衡会使某一模态主导优化，阻碍模型学习跨模态交互。现有动态平衡方法可调整模态贡献，却通常不考虑不平衡如何影响融合中协同信息的形成，而协同信息是单模态证据无法恢复的多模态增益来源。

Result: Multimodal Synergistic Competition Regularizer（MSCR）结合两个目标：反主导目标抑制过强单模态影响，为协同信息留下空间；协同目标鼓励融合预测优于非协同的单模态参考。自适应门控进一步将正则集中到更需要协作建模的样本。五个基准上，MSCR 持续超过 Multimodal Competition Regularizer（MCR），并强化协同能力：单模态预测错误样本上的融合正确率（conditional recovery）提升，InterSHAP 归因给跨模态交互的输出比例也提高。使用 Transformer 融合模块时条件恢复增益仍保持。

Abstract: In multimodal learning, modality imbalance often lets one modality dominate optimization and keeps the model from fully exploiting cross-modal interactions. Balance-oriented methods such as the Multimodal Competition Regularizer (MCR) perform well by alleviating this imbalance during training. These dynamic balancing methods, however, mainly adjust modality contributions and do not consider how imbalance affects the formation of synergistic information during fusion. Synergy is a major source of multimodal advantage, because it is predictive gain that cannot be recovered from unimodal evidence alone. We propose the Multimodal Synergistic Competition Regularizer (MSCR), a fusion method that jointly promotes balanced modality utilization and the discovery of synergistic information. MSCR has two complementary objectives. An anti-dominance objective suppresses excessive unimodal influence and leaves room for synergistic information, and a synergy objective encourages the fused predictor to outperform a non-synergistic unimodal reference. An adaptive gate further concentrates the regularization on samples that need stronger collaborative modeling. Experiments on five benchmarks show that MSCR consistently improves performance over MCR and strengthens synergistic capability. It raises conditional recovery, the accuracy of the fused prediction on samples that the unimodal predictors misclassify, as well as the share of the model’s output that InterSHAP attributes to cross-modal interactions. Its gain in conditional recovery persists when the fusion module is Transformer-based. Code is available at https://github.com/chenxinyu991-collab/MSCR.

Xinye Yang, Zhenyang Liu, Yuxuan Wang, Yuanyuan Lei

TL;DR: RLAWM 把物理推理失败定位为前提层世界模型偏离题目所给物理公理，并分别奖励模型是否正确建构世界和是否在其中正确推导；无需增加推理期成本，在 PhysReason、PHYSICS 和奥赛级测试上均提升表现。

Details

Motivation: 近期高难物理推理基准显示，模型错误有时不是缺知识或不会运算，而是擅自改动已知量、编造定律或加入题目未给的假设，再在错误世界中推理。现有可验证奖励或过程奖励并未直接监督物理等公理化领域中的世界建模。

Result: 作者将模型内部公理世界模型与题目规定物理世界的差异定义为 modeling drift，并提出仅在训练期运行的 RLAWM。它在建模和求解两个层级探测推理并提供物理约束奖励：建模奖励检查计算前是否正确抽象世界公理，求解奖励检查具体推导是否与这些公理一致。相较基线，RLAWM 在 PhysReason 上最高提升 12.2 分、在 PHYSICS 上提升 5.2 分；对难度、来源和领域可零样本泛化。在奥赛级物理与数学上，相比最强基线取得 2.45 倍增益和 10 分提升，推理阶段无额外成本。

Insight: 物理推理评估和训练应分别检查模型相信自己处于什么世界、以及它如何在该世界中演算，避免只奖励最终数值而忽略错误前提。摘要未给出各数据集指标定义及绝对分数。

Abstract: Recent research-level physics-reasoning benchmarks for LLMs reveal a failure mode that lies not in knowledge or execution, but in modeling the world being reasoned about. Models often silently alter given quantities, fabricate laws, or inject unstated assumptions to force a problem into familiar patterns, and then reason inside this corrupted world. We define this premise-level divergence as modeling drift: the gap between a model’s internal axiomatic world model (AWM) and the true physical world specified in the problem. Although RLVR and PRM have yielded substantial gains in mathematics and code, their reward shapes do not directly supervise world modeling in axiomatic domains such as physics. We propose Reinforcement Learning with Axiomatic World Modeling (RLAWM), which optimizes the policy by penalizing divergence between its inferred axiomatic world model and the true physics world. RLAWM probes physics reasoning at two hierarchical levels (modeling and solving), each scored by a physically grounded reward. The modeling reward targets abstract knowledge formulation, evaluating whether the model captures the true axiomatic world before attempting calculation. The solving reward targets instantiated knowledge reasoning, checking whether the model’s concrete derivation remains consistent with the axiomatic world. This two-level structure separates what world the model believes it is reasoning in from how it reasons within that world. The framework operates exclusively during training, with no extra cost during inference. RLAWM improves performance by up to +12.2 points on PhysReason and +5.2 on PHYSICS over the baseline. It also generalizes zero-shot across difficulty, source, and domain, with a 2.45x gain and +10 points over the strongest baseline on olympiad-level physics and math.

Ali Ansari, Farhana Ferdousi Liza

TL;DR: 该方法通过对齐检查、完整前提重检和失败归因审计人工推理参考链；P-FOLIO 的 386 条推导中仅 202 条（52.3%）通过全部检查，而被引用前提无法蕴含的 230 步里有 191 步可由完整前提推出，说明参考链本身也常有支持遗漏。

Details

Motivation: AI 推理系统常以人工推理链作为参考评估，但每一步是否真的由其引用的前提支持很少被系统核查。若参考推导或其形式化表示有误，与参考不一致就未必意味着 AI 系统推理错误。

Insight: 推理基准中的参考链和形式化翻译并非无误差真值；评估分歧可能来自参考支持缺失、人工推理、翻译或标注。结果限于 P-FOLIO 和现有逻辑表示，摘要未讨论其他基准的参考质量。

Abstract: Evaluating the reasoning of AI systems often relies on human-written reasoning chains as references, yet the logical support for their individual steps is rarely verified. Although prior neuro-symbolic approaches have formalized and checked reasoning, their reported evaluations do not systematically assess whether step conclusions in human-written reference derivations are entailed by their cited premise sets or investigate the sources of failures in those references. To address these limitations, we present a novel reference-centred assessment method for human-written derivations that combines entailment checking against cited premise sets, full-premise rechecking, and failure attribution to examine the reliability of these derivations and their formal representations. We evaluate it on P-FOLIO, using a large language model (LLM) to translate step conclusions into first-order logic (FOL) and the Z3 SMT solver to check entailment. Of 386 derivations examined, 202 (52.3%) meet all our checking criteria, meaning that every translated step is entailed by its stated support and the required target is established under the available FOL representations. Among 230 steps not entailed by their stated support, 191 become entailed when checked against the complete original premises, indicating that most initial failures reflect incomplete or mismatched support rather than unsupported claims. Manual analysis of the remaining 39 cases identifies 21 human reasoning errors, 11 FOL translation errors, and 7 dataset annotation errors. A separate manual audit of 50 randomly sampled steps that passed the entailment checks found 46 faithful FOL translations (92%). These findings suggest that disagreement with a human-written reasoning reference may originate in the reference or its formal representation rather than in the AI system being evaluated.

[251] Neuro-Inspired Inhibitory Message Passing for Accurate and Token-Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.MAPDF

Nima H. Siboni, Magdalena Springer, Vahid Rostami

TL;DR: 受神经抑制启发的消息传递路由器按接收方和证据句去重，只转发接收方尚未掌握的事实并抑制重复内容；相较标准消息传递，多智能体准确率提升 39–77 个百分点、每次运行 token 减少 10–46%。

Details

Motivation: 多智能体协作能汇集单个智能体难以获得的信息，但消息积累会挤占上下文，使关键而稀有的证据被大量重复内容淹没。皮层回路中的抑制机制提示，可选择性压低共享输入，同时保留较弱而有用的信号。

Result: 作者提出免训练抑制式消息传递路由器，逐接收方、逐证据句抵消冗余信息。每轮仅转发其他智能体消息中复述的证据句：每条最多给同一接收方一次，且只发给自身尚无该证据的接收方；发送者的推理过程与答案本身不转发。对比标准消息传递，三个基准上的同伴群组准确率提升 39–77 个百分点，每次运行 token 减少 10–46%。收益覆盖 7 个 4B–32B 开源模型和两个商业模型、最多 64 智能体，以及点对点、编排器—工作者和多级层次架构。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems promise to solve problems by bringing together information beyond the reach of any individual agent. Retrieval and tool use can distribute this information across agents, making communication essential to collaboration. A central challenge is keeping crucial evidence visible in each agent’s context as messages accumulate. Repeated information can crowd out rare, decisive evidence. The audit overturns this interpretation: PT2D localizes the strongest signal to identifiers in one tool result, and redacting them reduces performance to chance. These findings show how hidden label shortcuts can masquerade as scientific reasoning or discovery, motivating source-level audits before benchmark gains are trusted.

Abstract: Automated fact-checking (AFC) systems powered by large language model (LLM) agents still face challenges in evidence retrieval and claim verification. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SkillCheck improves upon skill-free DEFAME baselines across multiple LLM backbones, with gains of 2.2–4.8 pp. in Accuracy and 1.5–6.3 pp. in Macro-F1 on the AVeriTeC benchmark. Notably, SkillCheck with GPT-4o-Mini exceeds DEFAME with GPT-4o by 3.4 pp. in Accuracy while cutting inference cost by roughly 61%. The performance gains also extend to open-web retrieval. Ablations show that incorporating the skill during evidence retrieval provides most of the gains, while incorporation into both stages yields the best overall performance. Case studies show that PFC-Skill enables more targeted search and closer scrutiny of evidence. Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning can improve problem solving, but models often keep generating after the correct answer is already reachable; the extra steps raise serving costs and may replace a correct intermediate result with an incorrect one. GLOBE embeds each completed reasoning segment as a point on a unit sphere and reads the shape of the resulting semantic trajectory. GLOBE first applies a trial phase that generates short trial answers in a separate branch, stopping the main stream on an accepted trial after checking confidence against a threshold. If generation continues, a trajectory phase stops the stream once this path repeatedly reverses direction with little net progress. On five benchmarks including mathematical reasoning, tool calling, and agent memory, GLOBE cuts output tokens by 49.7% and active end-to-end wall time (E2E) by 51.0% across two models, and achieves a five-task average of 80.58%, comparable to Full CoT.

Abstract: Reflective text-space optimizers such as GEPA and SkillOpt have reported large gains on frontier and mid-size models. Abstract: Applying a legal provision frequently requires both structured rule-based reasoning and sensitivity to open-textured terms developed in case law. Abstract: Language-model agents increasingly solve complex tasks through parallel reasoning and asynchronous information gathering. This dependence persists after all initial evidence arrives and through a second search, turning temporary differences in what agents have seen into lasting differences in what they acquire. An acquisition-regret bound with a matching construction shows that invariance at a fixed early arrival count can limit the use of evidence already received. For a fixed plan and stable conditional response law, we prove joint invariance of decisions, acquisitions, and answers. With question-only plans across three benchmarks, CEA brings acquisition disagreement to within 1.0 percentage point of repeat variation and achieves accuracy comparable to complete-input controls, improving over early commitment by up to 12.6 percentage points. Replacing CEA’s fixed allocation with first-ready allocation under contention adds 21.6 percentage points of acquisition disagreement, while local query-target disagreement remains near repeat variation. Timed comparisons show that CEA reaches decisions earlier and responds faster than the same program waiting for all initial evidence.

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires agents to diagnose system bottlenecks and coordinate improvements across training and inference. We refer to the agents’ capability to jointly optimize training data, the trainer, and the inference harness as cross-component co-design. We introduce VibeTraining-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating this capability across tasks spanning terminal operation, software engineering, multi-turn tool use, and mathematical reasoning. Within each task, research agents start from an identical initial agent system under a fixed resource budget. Guided by validation feedback, they iteratively refine data, trainers, and inference harnesses, then select and submit a final agent system for evaluation on the test set. To prevent reward hacking, we enforce three safeguards: test data isolation, separate research and grading containers, and network restrictions for research agents. Our evaluation results show that frontier research agents substantially improve target agent systems. For example, on SWE-bench Verified, GPT-6-Astra raises the target agent system’s performance from 32.9% to 53.7%, comparable to the human-developed instruct model’s 55.4%. However, there is still room to improve their ability to co-design and iteratively refine data, trainer, and harness to achieve cumulative performance gains. We hope that VibeTraining-Bench will serve as a unified platform for advancing RSI, deepening our understanding of cross-component optimization for agent systems. Details

Motivation: 智能体 harness 决定多轮间保留、摘要或重放哪些历史内容，论文研究这些选择何时改变成功率，而非只比较成本；尤其关注被丢弃的状态能否在后续重新观察，以及模型自身早期推理是否值得重放。

Result: 预注册合成测试发现，当所需事实可再次查询时，截断上下文对低成本推理模型成功率没有影响，模型会重新查找；无法重观察时成功率降至随机水平，两种情况相差 92.5 个百分点（90% CI [89.5,95.5]）。第二提供商一个模型的预注册复现得到相同差异，事实丢失后模型选择不作答而非猜测。ARC-AGI-3 中，作者对一个模型、四款游戏逐项分解标准 harness 与 Provider Adapter 的差距：不再丢弃而是摘要旧轮次，同时保留标准 harness 的记笔记提示，可在不重放模型旧推理的情况下追回 63 分差距的 86%；没有记笔记提示时追回 43%，加入提供商原生推理重放后再追回其余 57%。这些是每种配置和游戏各一次计数的点估计，推理重放的占比受单次运行影响。已到达关卡上 Provider Adapter 优势在深层更大，但作者指出这基本复述了运行停止位置，不能区分优势是否随深度增加。

Insight: 上下文管理的影响取决于丢失事实能否重新观察；摘要历史与记笔记可能恢复长程任务表现，不一定需要重放模型先前推理。ARC-AGI-3 的 harness 结果样本很少，不能视为稳定估计。

Abstract: Agent harnesses decide what a language model sees across turns: they drop old turns, summarize them, or replay the model’s own earlier reasoning. We ask when these choices change whether an agent succeeds, not only what it costs, and report three findings. First, in a pre-registered synthetic probe, truncating the context window costs a low-cost reasoning model nothing in success when a needed fact can be looked up again (it looks the fact up instead), but drops its success to chance when the fact cannot be re-observed: the two penalties differ by 92.5 percentage points (90% CI [89.5, 95.5]). A pre-registered replication on one model from a second provider showed the same contrast. Once the fact was lost, that model chose no answer rather than guessing. Second, on ARC-AGI-3, where the benchmark’s Standard harness trails its Provider Adapter harness by a wide margin, we decompose that gap one component at a time, for one model on four games. Summarizing old turns instead of dropping them, while keeping the Standard harness’s invitation to take notes, recovers 86% of a 63-point gap without replaying the model’s reasoning. The same harness without the invitation recovers 43%, and adding the provider’s native replay of the model’s reasoning recovers the remaining 57%. These are point estimates from one counted run per configuration and game, and the replay share depends on a single run. Third, in the benchmark’s published runs and in ours, the Adapter’s advantage in the probability of clearing a level it has reached is larger at deep levels than at early ones. This largely restates where runs stopped and does not separate a growing advantage from a constant one.

[268] Defending Against Dormant Poisoning Attacks Across Language and Multimodal Agents cs.CR | cs.CL | cs.CVPDF

Wonjun Lee, Vaidehi Patil, Zaid Khan, Yue Zhang, Hyunji Lee

TL;DR: LookAhead Defense 利用模型发布时必须表现安全这一点，构造不依赖外部安全回答的 Safety Buffer，并预演良性微调、只惩罚预测会削弱安全性的更新；在语言模型、语言智能体和多模态智能体中均降低后门行为，同时维持较好效用并控制过度拒答。

Details

Motivation: 休眠投毒可在模型发布时隐藏恶意行为，待模型经过看似良性的微调后再触发；智能体还可能把潜伏行为扩展到未见动作，多个恶意行为也可能共同被触发。现有防御常需外部安全回答或可信干净参考模型，而智能体动作场景中这些资源难以获得，过度惩罚也会造成过度拒答或效用下降。

Result: 作者利用投毒者必须让发布模型表面安全的特性，自动构造 Safety Buffer：将有害输入与发布模型原有回答配对，并加入由同一模型生成、去除有害意图的良性版本。LookAhead Defense 用缓冲区预演良性微调更新，只惩罚预测会削弱有害输入安全性，或增加对良性版本拒答概率的更新。在语言模型、语言智能体和多模态智能体上，相较普通微调，有害智能体行为比例最高从 93.9% 降至至多 14.2%，语言模型有害回答最高从 92.5% 降至至多 2.0%，同时保持有竞争力的效用和较低过度拒答；对其他投毒方法也有效。

Insight: 发布阶段的安全行为本身可作为后续微调的安全参照，不必依赖外部干净模型或人工安全回答；预测性筛选更新还可避免把所有变化都一概惩罚。摘要没有给出各任务细分结果或安全性与效用的具体数值。

Abstract: Recent work shows that attackers can implant dormant malicious behaviors that remain hidden at release but emerge after benign fine-tuning. As foundation models are used as agents, whether dormant poisoning extends to harmful agent actions and multimodal settings remains unclear. We show two agentic risks: (1) harmful behaviors activated by benign fine-tuning can extend to unseen actions; (2) multiple harmful behaviors can coexist and be jointly activated by benign downstream fine-tuning. Existing defenses often rely on external safe responses, which are hard to obtain for agent actions, or a trusted clean reference model. We exploit a key property of dormant poisoning: the attacker must preserve safe behavior at release to conceal poisoning, and this behavior can serve as a safety reference. Leveraging this property, we automatically construct a Safety Buffer pairing harmful inputs with the released model’s responses and benign versions generated by the same model to remove harmful intent. The Safety Buffer can replace external safe responses in existing defenses, but these defenses do not distinguish updates that weaken safety from those that preserve it, often increasing over-refusal or reducing utility. To address this limitation, we introduce LookAhead Defense, which previews benign fine-tuning updates using the Safety Buffer and penalizes only updates predicted to weaken safe behavior on harmful inputs or increase the likelihood of refusals on benign versions in the Safety Buffer. Across language models, language agents, and multimodal agents, LookAhead Defense reduces harmful behavior in agents from up to 93.9% to at most 14.2% and harmful responses in language models from up to 92.5% to at most 2.0% versus vanilla fine-tuning, while maintaining competitive utility and low over-refusal. It remains effective against other poisoning methods.

[269] StreamAhead: Real-Time Streaming Video Question Answering via Adaptive Precomputation cs.DC | cs.CVPDF

Haoyang Fan, Dhruv Parikh, Rajgopal Kannan, Viktor Prasanna

TL;DR: StreamAhead 将实时视频片段保持在视觉特征到 KV 缓存的不同预计算层级，只对检索到的片段补全昂贵缓存，并用 CPU/GPU 流水并发隐藏查询计算；可持续 30 FPS 且 P95 首 token 延迟低于 0.5 秒，最高可达 57 FPS、P95 低于 2 秒。

Details

Motivation: 实时流式视频问答要求任意时刻到达的问题都能低延迟回答，同时持续处理应用要求的视频帧率。现有系统通常随视频到达就为全部内容构建 KV 缓存，但查询往往只用到此前少量帧，因此前处理与查询延迟存在权衡。

Result: StreamAhead 按视频片段独立编码，允许各片段停留在不同表示层级，从低成本视觉特征到高成本 KV 缓存；只有查询检索到的片段才在问题到达时补全缓存。系统离线测量片段推进到各层级的成本，运行时根据这些配置，在查询处理期间并发安排片段计算，并在异构 CPU/GPU 上流水化，同时维持视频处理速率。准确率与先进方法相当，首次 token 延迟最高比先进方法低 10.4 倍、比先进流系统低 5.9 倍；可维持 30 FPS 且 P95 延迟低于 0.5 秒，或达 57 FPS 且 P95 延迟低于 2 秒。

Insight: 按需预计算比对整段视频提前生成完整 KV 缓存更节省资源；需结合视频处理和查询执行动态调度以同时满足帧率与响应时延。摘要未给出不同查询密度下的成本或模型具体准确率。

Abstract: Real-time streaming video question answering with vision-language models must answer queries that arrive at any time with low latency while sustaining the video-processing rate required by the application. Existing systems construct key-value (KV) caches for the entire video as it arrives, although a query typically uses only a few of the preceding frames as evidence. This highlights a fundamental trade-off: performing more computation as video arrives reduces query-time computation but can increase processing lag, whereas deferring computation can increase the video-processing rate but requires additional query-time computation for retrieved content. We present StreamAhead, an algorithm-system co-design that exploits this trade-off through adaptive precomputation: dynamically controlling how much computation to complete for each video segment before a query arrives. StreamAhead encodes video segments independently and lets each remain at a different representation level, from inexpensive visual features to costly KV caches, completing KV caches only for the retrieved segments when a query arrives. StreamAhead profiles offline the cost of advancing a segment to each representation level. Its runtime uses these profiles to schedule segment computation concurrently with query execution, pipelining it across heterogeneous CPU and GPU resources while maintaining the required video-processing rate. StreamAhead achieves accuracy competitive with state-of-the-art methods with up to 10.4x lower time-to-first-token (TTFT), and up to 5.9x lower TTFT than state-of-the-art streaming systems. It sustains 30 FPS with P95 TTFT under 0.5 s, and up to 57 FPS with P95 TTFT under 2 s. To our knowledge, StreamAhead is the first real-time streaming video QA system with competitive accuracy, setting a new Pareto frontier between video-processing rate and TTFT.

[270] GazeAgent: VLM-Guided Implicit Gaze Calibration from Egocentric Multimodal Behavior for AI Glasses cs.HC | cs.CVPDF

Yuhong Zhang, Khanh An Nguyen, Xinyu Tian, KungYi Chang, Abraham Padua

TL;DR: GazeAgent 从 IMU、视线和佩戴者手部信号中识别自然发生的精确视觉注意事件，并将功能目标作为伪校准目标持续更新 AI 眼镜视线校准；10 人研究覆盖 820 个预设事件，设备受扰时中位视线误差比显式校准降低 44.1%。

Details

Motivation: AI 眼镜通常需要用户专属的显式眼动仪校准，设备在使用中移动后准确度还会漂移。若校准要求用户中断当前任务，交互负担较高。

Result: GazeAgent 是 VLM 引导的持续校准框架，从 IMU、眼动和佩戴者手部等多模态流识别精确视觉注意事件，验证其任务相关性，并把功能目标定位为伪校准目标，无需用户停下活动。在 10 名参与者的脚本研究中，系统检测到全部 820 个预设注意机会；设备受扰时，较显式校准中位视线误差降低 44.1%。另一个五人案例研究中，自动校准的工作负荷和中断评分最低，所有参与者都偏好日常使用自动校准。

Insight: 自然交互中已有的手部动作和注意线索可提供持续校准信号，减少专门校准步骤和设备位移造成的漂移。研究样本为 10 人和 5 人，摘要未报告设备型号、误差绝对值或长期佩戴效果。

Abstract: AI glasses typically require explicit, user-specific eye-tracker calibration, and accuracy can drift when the device shifts during use. We present GazeAgent, a VLM-guided framework that continuously and adaptively improves gaze-calibration accuracy from naturally occurring behavior without asking users to interrupt their activities. GazeAgent identifies precise visual attention (PVA) events from multimodal streams of inertial measurement unit (IMU), gaze, and wearer-hand signals, validates their task relevance, and localizes functional targets as pseudo-calibration targets. In a 10-participant scripted study, the system detected all 820 predefined PVA opportunities and, under device disturbance, reduced median gaze error by 44.1% compared with explicit calibration. In a five-participant case study, autonomous calibration produced the lowest workload and interruption ratings, and all participants preferred it for routine use. By deriving task-critical targets from natural multimodal behavior, GazeAgent demonstrates the potential for continuous, adaptive, and low-burden gaze interaction on egocentric AI glasses.

[271] Small Average Error, Wide Individual Error: General-Purpose LLMs Estimating Energy Intake from Meal Photos in a Feeding Trial cs.HC | cs.CV | q-bio.QMPDF

Xiaomeng Li

TL;DR: 在 802 餐受控膳食试验中，六种通用多模态模型估计“吃了多少能量”时，餐后照片对餐级误差仅再改善 2.2–3.4 分；没有模型满足预设的个体一致性界限，且所有模型都低估蛋白质。

Details

Motivation: 饮食能量照片估计可能减轻膳食评估负担，但多数评测只拍餐前照片并与供应能量比较，临床饮食评估实际需要估计摄入量。论文在有称重摄入真值的受控试验中比较餐前、餐后照片使用方式。

Result: 作者在 ACETADA 受控膳食试验的 802 餐上比较两家厂商六个模型，输入为餐前照片、分别调用餐前和餐后照片后相减，或一次同时输入两张照片。相减会使六个模型中的五个低估摄入量，因为即使托盘几乎空了，模型仍报告数百千卡。将餐前估计按平均吃掉比例 0.87 缩放，已获得餐后图像大部分收益；在此基础上，第二张图只再降低 2.2–3.4 分餐级误差，主要帮助有剩餐的情况。148 个膳食日中，三个模型的平均误差 90% 置信区间落在预设 10% 边界内，但没有模型满足预设 30% 一致性界限。所有模型均低估蛋白质，蛋白质密集餐最明显；重复调用误差变化最多 1.4 分；高推理预算只让最小模型提升 4.2 分，其余不到 1 分。

Insight: 较低平均偏差不等于个体摄入估计准确；作者明确认为这些模型应辅助而不能替代营养师评估。餐后照片主要改善有剩餐场景，蛋白质估计仍普遍偏低。

Abstract: Photo-based estimation of food energy could ease dietary assessment, and general-purpose multimodal large language models (LLMs) make such estimates easy to obtain. Most evaluations use one photo taken before eating and compare with energy served, while dietary assessment needs energy eaten. We evaluated six models from two vendors (Claude Haiku, Sonnet and Opus 5.5; GPT-6 luna, 6.1 sol and 6 astra) on 802 meals from ACETADA, a controlled feeding trial with weighed intake, with the before photo only, before and after photos in separate calls (subtraction), or both photos in one request. Three results ran against intuition. Subtraction under-estimated intake for five of six models, because the models still report hundreds of kilocalories for a nearly empty tray. Scaling the before-only estimate by the average share eaten (0.87) matched much of the gain from the after photo; beyond that constant, the second photo lowered meal-level error by only 2.2 to 3.4 points, mainly in meals with food left. With one photo, two models had a near-zero intake bias only because they under-estimated the served energy and ignored uneaten food. In ablations, adding the after photo improved accuracy under both prompt formats for five models, while prompt effects varied across models. Over 148 feeding days, three models kept the 90% confidence interval of their mean error within a pre-set 10% margin, but no model reached the pre-set 30% limits of agreement. Protein was under-estimated by every model, most in protein-dense meals; repeated calls changed error by at most 1.4 points; a high reasoning effort helped only the smallest model (4.2 points) and changed the others by less than 1 point. A low average bias is not evidence of accurate individual intake estimation; such estimates should support, not replace, assessment by a dietitian.

[272] Cross-Pollination Retrieval: Finding Transferable Ideas Across Fields in Scientific Literature cs.IR | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Seokwon Jung, Yerang Kim, Yejin Kim, Alexander Rubinstein, Arnas Uselis

TL;DR: CPR-Dataset 将跨领域可迁移思想检索形式化，并提供 26 个领域的 1,300 个测试查询与 10,573 个训练对；对比学习微调将 Recall@10 提至最高 0.70，并迁移改善类比和推理密集检索，在 BRIGHT 上 nDCG@10 提升最高 70%。

Details

Motivation: 许多科学进展来自把一个领域的思想迁移到另一领域，但跨学科论文检索尚未充分研究，现有基准只覆盖少数领域。论文提出跨领域思想迁移检索任务并构建大规模数据资源。

Result: CPR-Dataset 从跨主题引用中挖掘训练与评测样本，测试集 CPR-eval 含 26 个领域中的 1,300 个查询，训练集 CPR-train 含 10,573 对。CPR-eval 上，11 种现有检索器中最佳 Recall@10 仅为 0.26，LLM 重排器为 0.81；在 CPR-train 上标准对比微调可将 Recall@10 提高至最高 0.70。增益可迁移至训练未见领域和类比、推理密集检索：AnaloBench 上相较未训练检索器 nDCG@10 最高提高 33%，BRIGHT 上提高最高 70%，超过使用三种既有检索数据集训练的两倍收益。

Insight: 跨领域检索需要识别可迁移的思想，而非只匹配主题相近文本；专门构造的跨主题引用监督还可能提升类比和推理型检索。摘要未报告 LLM 重排器成本或不同领域的细分结果。

Abstract: Many scientific advances come from cross-pollination, carrying an idea from one field over to a problem in another. Yet retrieving papers across fields remains underexplored, with existing benchmarks confined to a narrow range of fields. We study cross-pollination retrieval, the problem of identifying transferable ideas across research fields, and introduce CPR-Dataset, a large-scale dataset constructed by mining cross-topic citations. Its evaluation split CPR-eval has 1,300 queries in 26 fields, and its training split CPR-train has 10,573 pairs. On CPR-eval, the best of eleven existing retrievers reaches a Recall@10 of only 0.26, whereas an LLM reranker reaches 0.81. Standard contrastive fine-tuning on CPR-train raises Recall@10 to as high as 0.70. The gain carries over to domains held out from training and to analogy and reasoning-intensive retrieval. On AnaloBench, it raises nDCG@10 by up to 33% over the untrained retriever, whereas training on three existing retrieval datasets lowers it. On BRIGHT, it raises nDCG@10 by up to 70%, more than twice the gain from those datasets. CPR-Dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/CPR-Dataset, and the code at https://github.com/SeokwonJung-Jay/Cross-Pollination-Retrieval.

[273] MAPS: A Multi-Agent Personalized Script-Driven Video Advertising System Enhanced by Reinforcement Learning cs.IR | cs.CV | cs.MAPDF

Zhongyu Wang, Chen Zuo, Qingxuan Sun, Jiayang Qiao, Qiuhao Qian

TL;DR: MAPS 用四个协作智能体组成用户建模、脚本生成、视频合成和反馈迭代闭环，并以多维强化学习奖励训练脚本智能体；快手特定场景的在线 A/B 实验较生成式基线 CTR 提高 2.87%、CVR 提高 2.74%、ARPU 提高 9.85%。

Details

Motivation: 常见个性化视频广告通过特征匹配，从预制创意中推荐相似候选，个性化粒度有限，也容易造成不同用户群效果差异。论文希望直接生成更贴合个人偏好和商品信息的广告创意。

Result: MAPS 将用户画像建模、广告脚本生成、视频合成和反馈驱动的迭代优化分配给四个协作智能体，形成闭环创意生成流程。脚本智能体通过强化学习训练，使用多维奖励同时引导脚本匹配用户内容偏好与目标商品信息。代表性数据集的离线实验显示个性化创意生成和整合表现积极；快手广告系统一个特定场景的在线 A/B 测试中，较生成式基线 CTR 提升 2.87%、CVR 提升 2.74%、ARPU 提升 9.85%。

Insight: 将创意生成拆成画像、脚本、视频和反馈优化阶段，使个性化能作用于广告内容本身，而不只是在预制候选中排序。在线收益来自特定广告场景，摘要未说明其他场景或用户群的效果。

Abstract: With the rapid growth of online video consumption, video advertising has become a dominant component of digital advertising. Most personalized video advertising systems follow a retrieval-based paradigm, which matches ad content with user preferences in a feature space and recommends the most similar candidates. However, since the candidate creatives are pre-produced, this paradigm limits the granularity of personalization and leads to performance disparities across diverse user groups. To address this limitation, we propose a multi-agent personalized script-driven video advertising system (MAPS). We design four collaborative agents that form a closed-loop pipeline of user profile modeling, script generation, video synthesis, and feedback-driven iterative refinement. To train the Scripter Agent, we develop a reinforcement learning framework equipped with a multi-dimensional reward function, which steers the agent toward producing scripts that simultaneously align with user content preferences and target product information. Extensive offline experiments on representative datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves encouraging performance in generating and integrating personalized creatives. Online A/B experiments in a specific scenario in the Kuaishou advertising system show that MAPS improves CTR by 2.87%, CVR by 2.74%, and ARPU by 9.85% over the generative baseline.

[274] Dependency, Compression, and Synergy: A Unified Information-Theoretic View of Multimodal Learning cs.IT | cs.AI | cs.CV | cs.LGPDF

Liangjian Wen, Linjie Li, Jiang Duan, Yong Dai, Jianzhuang Liu

TL;DR: 该综述将互信息、信息瓶颈和部分信息分解统一为多模态信息处理视角：分别刻画模态依赖、任务导向压缩下的信息保留，以及冗余、独有与协同信息；它整理 170 篇近年研究和 12 篇基础工作并提出统一信息拉格朗日坐标系。

Details

Motivation: 多模态基础模型的发展使理解模态如何共享、保留和互补信息更重要，但已有研究常把互信息（MI）、信息瓶颈（IB）和部分信息分解（PID）视为互不相干的工具。

Result: 综述把 MI、IB、PID 视为逐步细化的信息处理视角：MI 描述模态间依赖，IB 解释压缩时如何保留任务相关信息，PID 将保留信息分成冗余、独有和协同部分。作者回顾 170 篇 2018–2026 年研究和 12 篇基础工作，按跨模态对齐、信息高效融合、交互类型刻画及多模态基础模型扩展四项挑战组织文献，并把医疗、机器人、推荐、情感计算和无线通信等应用视作信息原理的实证场景。综述进一步提出 Generalized Multimodal Information Lagrangian 统一坐标系，将现有多模态范式视为精确或近似参数特例，并标出尚未探索的参数区域及候选方法族。

Insight: 统一的信息论坐标系可帮助比较多模态学习方法在依赖、压缩和协同信息上的取舍，而不是按应用领域孤立分类。摘要指出的开放问题包括高维信息估计扩展性、标准化评测、PID 组合复杂度，以及从事后分析转向信息感知训练。

Abstract: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have intensified the need to understand how different modalities share, preserve, and complement information. Mutual Information (MI), the Information Bottleneck (IB), and Partial Information Decomposition (PID) provide complementary perspectives, yet existing studies often treat them as isolated tools. This survey presents an information-theoretic perspective connecting these principles as progressively refined views of multimodal information processing: MI characterizes inter-modal dependency, IB explains task-oriented information preservation under compression, and PID decomposes preserved information into redundancy, uniqueness, and synergy. We review 170 recent studies (2018–2026) and 12 foundational works, organizing multimodal learning around four challenges: cross-modal alignment, information-efficient fusion, interaction-type characterization, and scaling to multimodal foundation models. Rather than using application domains as primary taxonomy axes, we interpret healthcare, robotics, recommendation systems, affective computing, and wireless communications as empirical validations of these information principles. Beyond taxonomy, we organize existing multimodal paradigms within a single information-theoretic coordinate system – the Generalized Multimodal Information Lagrangian – in which they occupy exact or approximate parameter corners, and whose unoccupied regions name candidate method families the literature has not yet built. We further discuss how emerging multimodal foundation models instantiate these principles at scale and identify open challenges including scalable information estimation in high-dimensional settings, standardized evaluation across information-theoretic methods, combinatorial complexity of multimodal PID, and the transition from post-hoc information analysis toward information-aware multimodal learning.
