[275] SAGE-CP: When Marginal Coverage Hides Route-Conditional Failures in Adaptive VLM Ensembles cs.LG | cs.CVPDF

Mushir Akhtar, M. Tanveer

TL;DR: SAGE-CP 将自适应 VLM 集成的共形校准按早停与升级路径分别进行，避免边际覆盖掩盖某一路径严重失准；10 个基准、4 个冻结 VLM 上，最差路径覆盖率从 0.623 提至 0.887，路径间覆盖差距从 0.324 降至 0.025。

Details

Motivation: 自适应 VLM 集成可对简单图像提前停止、对困难样本升级模型以省计算。单一共形阈值虽能保证整体边际覆盖，却可能让个别计算路径的条件覆盖率很低，造成实际部署风险。

Result: SAGE-CP 先用开发集训练路由器并冻结所有路由决策，再对提前退出和升级输入分别校准返回分数；校准采用针对路由所形成操作组的 Mondrian split conformal prediction，在可交换假设下为每条路径提供有限样本覆盖率保证。跨 10 个基准、4 个冻结 VLM、5 个对齐划分，整体目标覆盖率 0.90 时，普通全局校准和 SAGE-CP 均实现 0.900 边际覆盖，但路径可靠性不同：SAGE-CP 将平均最差路径覆盖率从 0.623 提至 0.887，将平均路径覆盖差从 0.324 降至 0.025，源模型调用数相同，为每张图 1.177 次。预测集平均大小从 1.893 增至 2.212，仍小于完整集成的 2.486，同时源调用少 70.6%。相较完整推理，五个数据集上 batch-one 延迟降低 58.8–63.4%，GPU 能耗降低 55.7–57.5%；更细的退出深度组在稀有路径上需要更多校准数据。

Insight: 整体覆盖保证无法自动保护路由产生的每一种操作路径；需在冻结路由后分组校准并报告最差路径可靠性。更强路径保证会扩大预测集合，而罕见路径仍受校准样本量限制。

Abstract: Adaptive VLM ensembles save computation by stopping early on easy images and escalating harder ones. Although a single conformal threshold can make the final predictor marginally valid, it can still fail severely along individual computational routes. We characterize this failure precisely: if a route has prevalence pi, marginal 1-alpha coverage allows its conditional coverage to fall to max{0, 1-alpha/pi}. To address this mismatch, we learn the router on development data, freeze all routing choices, and calibrate the returned score separately for early exits and escalated inputs. We call this pipeline SAGE-CP. Its calibration step applies Mondrian split conformal prediction to the operational groups created by the router. Under exchangeability, the resulting prediction sets achieve finite-sample coverage within each route. Across 10 benchmarks, 4 frozen VLMs, and 5 aligned splits, both global calibration and SAGE-CP achieve 0.900 marginal coverage at a 0.90 target, but their route behavior differs substantially. SAGE-CP raises mean worst-route coverage from 0.623 to 0.887 and reduces the mean route-coverage gap from 0.324 to 0.025, using the same routed scores and 1.177 source calls per image. The stronger guarantee increases the mean prediction-set size from 1.893 to 2.212; nevertheless, the sets remain smaller than those of the full ensemble (2.486) while requiring 70.6 percent fewer source calls. The route-level reliability persists across 6 fixed query fractions, while finer exit-depth groups demonstrate the need for additional calibration data on rare routes. Across 5 datasets, SAGE-CP also reduces measured batch-one latency by 58.8 to 63.4 percent and gross GPU energy by 55.7 to 57.5 percent relative to full inference. Thus, routing provides computational savings, while route-stratified calibration attaches coverage guarantees to the operational paths created by the router.

[276] How Data Scales in Agentic Reinforcement Learning: Laws and Synthesis Strategies cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Bowei He, Yankai Chen, Xiaokun Zhang, Changjiang Han, Ye Yuan

TL;DR: 论文把智能体强化学习数据拆成任务、环境和轨迹三个可扩展维度，并拟合多模型、多领域的缩放关系；实测环境规模的缩放效应强于任务、任务又强于轨迹，按推导的预算配方训练可比主流“只扩轨迹”方案提高最高 1.7 倍计算效率。

Details

Motivation: 预训练缩放通常把数据简化为 token 数，但智能体强化学习的数据管线可以分别合成任务、环境和交互轨迹，且各自成本不同。给定合成预算，应该扩大哪类数据成为新的设计问题。

Result: 研究将智能体数据分为任务数、环境数、轨迹数三个轴，并将奖励密度作为控制变量；在数学与代码、软件工程、网页及 UI/工具应用领域，对不同语言模型拟合各轴缩放关系。所测模型规模、模型家族、领域及 PPO/GRPO 算法中，指数排序均为环境大于任务、大于轨迹。拆分环境多样性后，优势主要来自世界本身的多样性，环境结构多样性则约与任务多样性相当。作者进一步为数据合成方法估算各轴效率折扣和合成/真实比例坍缩阈值，并据此构造受约束的计算最优预算配方，在留出规模验证，最高获得 1.7 倍计算效率。

Insight: 智能体数据的“量”是多维的，环境多样性可能比堆积更多交互轨迹更有效；且合成数据风险阈值随数据轴相差一个数量级，不能用统一比例控制。报告的最高效率提升是在所测配方和实践对照范围内。

Abstract: Pretraining scaling laws treat training data as a one-dimensional quantity: a token count. Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) inherits this scalar abstraction, but modern synthesis pipelines now generate \textit{tasks}, \textit{environments}, and \textit{trajectories} independently and at very different costs, turning data into a structured design space. This raises a question pretraining never had to answer: given a synthesis budget, \textit{which axis} should be scaled? We address this question end-to-end with three tightly coupled contributions. First, we decompose agentic data into three cardinality axes (task, environment, trajectory), plus a reward-density control variable, and fit per-axis scaling relations on different large language models (LLMs) across math+code, SWE, web, and UI/tool application domains. Across all model sizes, model families, domains, and RL algorithms (PPO and GRPO) we measured, the scaling exponents order as environment $>$ task $>$ trajectory. When environment diversity is decomposed into world and environment-structure diversity, its advantage is mainly driven by the former, while the latter is just comparable to the task diversity. Second, we use the fitted laws as a common ruler to price synthesis methods, capturing each method’s efficiency as a per-axis discount factor and identifying critical synthetic-to-real ratios at which collapse begins; these ratios differ by an order of magnitude across axes. Third, we cast budget allocation as a constrained optimization under our laws and discounts, deriving a Chinchilla-style compute-optimal recipe and validating it at held-out scale. The empirical results demonstrate that following the recipe yields up to $1.7\times$ compute efficiency over the dominant ``scale-the-trajectories’’ practice.

[277] DISCERN: Identifiable Disease Evidence for Generalizable Medical Multimodal Learning cs.LG | cs.CV | q-bio.QMPDF

Xiaoguang Zhu, Pengyi Jiang, Juncen Guo, Jingyi Wu, Lianlong Sun

TL;DR: DISCERN 将跨队列医疗多模态偏差建模为潜在结构因果偏移，并从跨队列状态对齐和自然参数变化识别最小选择统计量；合成反向入组实验的状态 AUROC 从 0.043/0.265 提升至 0.883/0.825，eICU 与 MIMIC-IV 死亡率迁移较 ERM 高 0.036/0.035。

Details

Motivation: 临床多模态模型可能在多个模态中共同学习入组捷径，在新队列上失效。论文将数据表示为潜在结构因果模型：疾病状态和背景因素经共享机制产生生理观测，而不同队列在样本选择和测量方式上存在差异。

Result: 在采集方式固定的假设下，DISCERN 不需观察疾病状态标签或恢复完整因果模型，也可识别条件疾病证据。基于共同高斯坐标，跨队列状态对齐和自然参数变化可识别最小选择统计量；对其条件化可去除依赖入组的证据，并在指定偏移族内得到可识别参考后验。状态相关交互可能携带单模态后验看不到的证据，因此框架结合信息格编码器、潜状态模型和结局头联合训练。已知潜变量坐标的反向合成入组实验中，条件化使两组状态 AUROC 分别从 0.043、0.265 升到 0.883、0.825，随机条件化无此效果。eICU 与 MIMIC-IV 跨数据库死亡率探索实验中，AUROC 较匹配 ERM 高 0.036 和 0.035。

Insight: 跨队列泛化需要区分疾病状态信息与队列入组/测量机制；联合多模态交互也可能保留单模态后验无法体现的疾病证据。真实数据库结果是探索性比较，摘要未证明所有坐标或偏移设定下都可识别。

Abstract: Clinical multimodal models can learn enrollment shortcuts shared across modalities and fail on new cohorts. We model these data through a latent structural causal model: disease state and background factors generate physiology through shared mechanisms, while cohorts differ in selection and measurement. Holding acquisition fixed, we identify conditional disease evidence without observing disease-state labels or recovering the full causal model. In common Gaussian coordinates, cross-cohort state alignment and natural-parameter changes identify a minimal selection statistic; conditioning on it removes enrollment-dependent evidence and yields an identifiable reference posterior within the specified shift family. State-dependent interactions can carry evidence invisible to individual-modality posteriors, motivating joint, information-preserving representations. DISCERN combines an information-lattice encoder, a latent-state model, and an outcome head through joint training. Under reversed synthetic enrollment on known latent coordinates, conditioning raises state AUROC from 0.043 to 0.883 and from 0.265 to 0.825, while random conditioning does not. Exploratory cross-database mortality experiments between eICU and MIMIC-IV improve AUROC over matched empirical risk minimization by 0.036 and 0.035. Learned-coordinate diagnostics distinguish preservation of state information from identification of the coordinates required by the estimator.

[278] Inside the Loop: A Mechanistic Study of Weight-Tied Transformers on Depth-Bound Algorithmic Tasks cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Magnus Sesodia, Juil Sock, Philip Torr, Christian Schroeder de Witt

TL;DR: 在有逐跳真值的置换遍历任务上，循环 Transformer 表现得像迭代程序学习器：四层模块循环八次时所有随机种子均解出任务，而同有效深度、相同训练方式的非共享权重模型一次也未成功。

Details

Motivation: 逐步算法任务通常需要增加 Transformer 深度或延长思维链，分别提高参数规模或推理计算。循环 Transformer 反复使用同一层模块，可以不增加参数和 token 而提高有效深度，但每轮到底计算什么、它是否只是模拟更深的普通堆叠仍不清楚。

Result: 作者研究有明确中间真值的有向置换遍历：模型从起点沿 H 跳前进并报告终点。结果显示任务需要最低有效深度，超过后权重共享程度成为关键因素。四层模块循环八次的模型在每个随机种子均成功；相同有效深度、相同训练方式的非共享模型从未成功，只有降低学习率或监督其中间层后才可解。对残差流的探测和干预显示，循环模型逐轮推进中间节点，形成随迭代预算调整的阶梯；降低学习率的非共享模型则只在最后几层显露中间节点。

Insight: 循环结构可能通过在每次复用中执行算法的下一步来学习迭代程序，而非仅以较少参数模拟普通深层网络。实验限定于置换遍历任务，摘要未报告自然语言推理或其他算法任务的验证。

Abstract: Solving algorithmic tasks with many sequential steps typically requires scaling up transformer depth or chain-of-thought length, incurring unfavorable parameter and inference-compute costs, respectively. Looped transformers, which reuse one block of layers across many iterations, are poised to address this, since they scale effective depth without adding parameters or tokens. Yet, it remains unclear what each iteration is actually computing, or whether the loop merely simulates a deeper untied stack. Here, we study directed permutation traversal, in which a model follows $H$ hops from a starting node and reports the node it reaches, so every intermediate hop has a known ground truth. We find that a minimum effective depth is necessary to solve the task, beyond which the degree of weight tying becomes the determining factor. For instance, a looped transformer with a four-layer block iterated eight times solves the task in every seed, while an identically-trained untied transformer of the same effective depth never does, succeeding only with a lower learning rate or supervision of its intermediate layers. Probing and intervening on the residual stream, we find that the looped model advances through the intermediate nodes gradually, forming a staircase that adapts to its iteration budget, whereas the untied model, at that lower rate, exposes them only in its final layers. Taken together, our results recast looped transformers as iterative program learners, which allocate their iterations to successive steps of the algorithm and solve tasks that identically-trained untied models of the same effective depth do not. Code is available at https://github.com/magnus-sesodia/insidetheloop.

[279] Continual Test-Time Learning with Evolution Strategies cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Guangya Hao, Yiting Duan, Longyan Tan, Yunbo Long, Hao Wu

TL;DR: ESRL 用锚点策略附近的一组扰动策略共同产生无标签组相对学习信号，避免持续测试时适应只依赖正在变化的单一策略而导致监督漂移；在数学、常识和医学任务上平均准确率较基础模型最高提高 31.7%，较最强测试时适应基线提高 16.6%，并减轻灾难性遗忘。

Details

Motivation: 开放环境中的语言模型需持续适应变化任务，但标签、示范或奖励等外部监督可能昂贵或不可用。测试时适应可用模型自生成监督，但若监督也由正在更新的单一策略产生，策略漂移会使学习信号跟着变差，最终导致崩溃、推理退化和遗忘。

Result: Evolution Strategy Reinforcement Learning（ESRL）在参数空间扰动锚点策略形成一组邻近策略，每个策略采样一条轨迹，再汇总答案形成无标签组相对信号来训练中心学生。锚点在每个训练块内固定，并在块边界依据学生刷新，使策略群围绕稳定且不过时的中心提供多样监督。单任务测试时适应覆盖数学推理、一般知识和医学领域，平均准确率相对基础模型最多提升 31.7%，相对最强测试时适应基线最多提升 16.6%；持续学习实验中显著减少灾难性遗忘，并取得最高最终表现。

Insight: 多个邻近策略的群体信号可降低单个自适应策略同时充当学习者和监督者所带来的反馈漂移。报告的最高增幅跨任务平均，摘要未提供各领域分项结果、扰动群体计算开销或持续学习任务序列细节。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly operate in open-ended environments, where they are expected to continually adapt to evolving tasks and distributions, often without access to external supervision. Existing continual learning approaches rely on external supervision, such as labeled data, demonstrations, or reward signals, which can be costly or unavailable in practice. Test-time adaptation removes this dependence by learning from self-generated supervision, but existing methods derive that supervision from the single policy being updated, so once the policy drifts, its own learning signal drifts with it, leading to policy collapse, degraded reasoning, and catastrophic forgetting. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Evolution Strategy Reinforcement Learning (ESRL)}, a continual test-time learning framework that draws its self-generated supervision from a population of policies instead of the single policy being trained. ESRL perturbs an anchor policy in parameter space to form a population of nearby policies, samples one trajectory from each, and aggregates their answers into label-free group-relative learning signals for the central student. The anchor is held fixed within each block and refreshed from the student at block boundaries, so the population stays centered on a stable yet current policy and continues to supply diverse and reliable supervision as the student moves. In single-task test-time adaptation across mathematical reasoning, general knowledge, and medical domains, ESRL improves average accuracy by up to 31.7% relative to the base model and 16.6% relative to the strongest test-time adaptation baseline. Notably, ESRL substantially reduces catastrophic forgetting and achieves the strongest final performance in continual learning.

[280] ProbePO: Sparse Probes, Redistributed Credit for Critic-Free LLM Reinforcement Learning cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Diyi Hu, Ruizhong Qiu, Lin Qiu, Hanghang Tong, Hanqing Zeng

TL;DR: ProbePO 用有限的续写预算挑选不确定的部分推理状态进行稀疏验证，再将探针价值重新分配到原轨迹 token，同时保持轨迹平均优势不变；在 18 个模型—基准组合中有 16 个取得四种方法中的最高准确率，并比 VinePPO 少 76% 端到端训练时间。

Details

Motivation: 可验证奖励强化学习通常只给整条推理轨迹一个终端奖励，无法指出哪些步骤促成结果。GRPO 将组归一化优势广播到所有响应 token；更细粒度方法则可能需要密集额外 rollout 或分支，并改变用于策略更新的数据。

Result: ProbePO 将中间环节视为预算受限测量：根据不依赖奖励的不确定性分数选取部分解题状态，在受限续写预算内估计其期望验证器奖励。随后，它重新分配而非替换 GRPO 的轨迹级优势，并保持每条轨迹 token 级优势的均值不变；探针续写只用于测量。在 1.5B–7B 的 DeepSeekMath 和 Qwen 系列三个模型上，ProbePO 一贯优于 GRPO，并在 18 个模型—基准比较中的 16 个获得四种被评方法里最高准确率。对 DeepSeekMath-7B，ProbePO 在六个基准上全部高于密集探针 VinePPO，端到端训练时间减少 76%。

Insight: 稀疏测量中间步骤的价值可以改善信用分配，而不必把额外探针 rollout 混入策略训练数据或改变轨迹整体优势。摘要未解释其余两个比较未夺冠的具体结果，也未给出推理/验证额外开销。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards assigns one terminal reward to an entire reasoning trajectory, obscuring how individual reasoning steps contributed to the outcome. GRPO broadcasts a group-normalized advantage to every response token, while finer-grained approaches often rely on dense auxiliary rollouts or branching schemes that can also alter the data used for policy updates. We cast the missing middle as budgeted measurement: with a limited rollout budget, which partial solutions should be evaluated, and how should their value estimates refine credit? ProbePO selects partial-solution states with a reward-free uncertainty score and estimates their expected verifier rewards under a capped continuation budget. ProbePO redistributes, rather than replaces, GRPO’s trajectory-level advantage across tokens while preserving each trajectory’s mean token-level advantage; probe continuations serve only as measurements. Across three DeepSeekMath and Qwen-family models spanning 1.5B-7B parameters, ProbePO consistently outperforms GRPO and achieves the highest accuracy among the four evaluated methods in 16 of 18 model-benchmark comparisons. Against dense-probing VinePPO on DeepSeekMath-7B, ProbePO achieves higher accuracy on all six benchmarks with 76% less end-to-end training time.

[281] Structured Latent Dynamics for Long-Horizon Embodied World Models cs.LG | cs.CVPDF

Kevin Chen, Yu-Wei Zhan, Haoran Liang, Sen Cui, Changshui Zhang

TL;DR: HWM 将世界模型潜变量拆为广义坐标与动量，并以耗散 Hamilton 动力学传播未来状态，再映射回原潜空间；受控模拟中速度、加速度、急动度估计更准确且长程能量漂移降低，RoboCasa 成功率相对提升 2.7%。

Details

Motivation: 具身世界模型可生成视觉上合理的动作条件未来，但无约束潜空间转移在递归 rollout 中可能逐渐偏离连贯物理演化，影响长时预测稳定性与规划价值。

Result: Structured Latent Dynamics（HWM）把骨干模型潜表示转换为学习的相空间，包括广义坐标和动量；未来状态通过耗散 Hamilton 动力学传播，再由可学习逆接口映射回原始潜表示。该结构可接入现有世界模型，不必重做感知或解码模块，多步转移监督使 rollout 对齐真实观察潜轨迹。受控模拟中，HWM 更准确估计速度、加速度和急动度，并显著减少长程能量漂移。进一步在 Ctrl-World 单臂多视角、EVAC 双臂单视角和 Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B 任务导向单臂等三类世界模型评测：RoboCasa 上任务成功率相对提高 2.7%；真实 AgiBot World 轨迹上，Ctrl-World 的 nDTW 提高 9.7%，EVAC 的 Logic 指标提高 8.4%。

Insight: 为潜在状态显式加入坐标—动量结构和耗散动力学，可为多步世界预测增加物理稳定性约束，同时保留原模型接口。摘要未给各模型全部任务结果或仿真物理指标数值。

Abstract: Reliable long-horizon prediction remains a central challenge for embodied world models. Although recent generative models can synthesize visually plausible action-conditioned futures, their latent dynamics are typically learned through unconstrained transition modules, which may gradually deviate from coherent physical evolution as predictions are recursively rolled forward. We investigate whether explicitly structuring latent state evolution can improve the stability and utility of such imagined trajectories. To this end, we introduce HWM, a structured dynamics framework that represents backbone latents in a learned phase space consisting of generalized coordinates and momenta. Future states are propagated through dissipative Hamiltonian dynamics and mapped back to the original latent representation through a learnable inverse interface. The resulting formulation can be integrated into existing world-model architectures without redesigning their perception or decoding components, while multi-step transition supervision encourages the structured rollout to remain aligned with the latent trajectories induced by real observations. Controlled simulation experiments show that HWM produces more accurate estimates of velocity, acceleration, and jerk and substantially reduces long-horizon energy drift relative to unstructured latent dynamics. We further evaluate the approach across three distinct embodied world-model settings, covering single-arm multi-view prediction with Ctrl-World, dual-arm single-view prediction with EVAC, and task-oriented single-arm prediction with Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B. On RoboCasa, incorporating HWM into Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B yields a 2.7% relative improvement in task success. On real-world AgiBot World trajectories, it improves nDTW by 9.7% with Ctrl-World and Logic by 8.4% with EVAC.

[282] Arctic-SWE: Revisiting the Long Horizon Agent Training by Modeling-System Co-Design cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Boyi Liu, Yite Wang, Xinyu Lian, Fan Shu, Sida Li

TL;DR: Arctic-SWE 通过模型—系统协同构建异步智能体强化学习基线，使用小任务池过拟合测试揭露早期奖励掩盖的问题；仅用原始 R2E-Gym 训练 Qwen3.5-4B 即在 SWE-bench Verified 达到 62.0% pass@1，约为 FrogNano rollout 数的六分之一。

Details

Motivation: 软件工程等长时智能体强化学习快速发展，但强基线的训练配方和基础设施难以复现，使新算法或数据的收益可能只是弥补了基线调优不足。论文希望建立可复现的异步 RL 基础，并分辨任务训练成绩与留出泛化。

Result: Arctic-SWE 是全异步 RL 框架，以小任务池过拟合作为测试平台，整合门控奖励、重要性权重控制、训练与推理引擎对齐及策略更新间状态一致性等组件。使用原始 R2E-Gym、没有新算法或数据处理时，它将 Qwen3.5-4B 训练到 SWE-bench Verified 62.0% pass@1，与依赖在线任务合成的 FrogNano 61.5% 相当，rollout 约少六倍。进一步筛选和整理 R2E-Gym、SWE-rebench V2、Scale-SWE 后，4B 在 Verified/Pro-v1/Pro-v2 上由 47.4%/25.0%/37.9% 升至 65.0%/38.3%/59.7%；9B 则由 56.2%/31.9%/48.8% 升至 65.7%/39.6%/70.2%。受控比较显示数据整理和加强测试均改善留出表现，但更强测试会降低表面上的训练任务掌握度。

Insight: 长时智能体 RL 的成绩高度依赖训练与推理基础设施以及任务池测试强度，不能把早期奖励提升直接归因于算法进步。论文分别报告原始数据基线和整理数据结果，摘要未列训练总时长或资源配置。

Abstract: Long-horizon agent training, including software engineering, is advancing rapidly, but the recipe and infrastructure needed for a strong reinforcement-learning baseline remain difficult to reproduce. This makes gains from new algorithms or data hard to distinguish from improvements to an under-tuned baseline. We present Arctic-SWE, a fully asynchronous RL framework that establishes such a baseline through model-system co-design, using overfitting on a small task pool as the testbed. This testbed exposes failures that early reward gains conceal and guides the integration of established components: gated reward, importance-weight control, aligned training and inference engines, and consistent state across policy updates. No single component is new, yet together they form the missing foundation. On raw R2E-Gym data, without new algorithms or data work, Arctic-SWE trains Qwen3.5-4B to 62.0% pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified. This is comparable to concurrent FrogNano (61.5%), which relies on online task synthesis, after about one-sixth as many training rollouts. Building on this foundation, we further filter and refine R2E-Gym, SWE-rebench V2, and Scale-SWE. With this curated subset, the 4B model improves from 47.4%/25.0%/37.9% to 65.0%/38.3%/59.7% on SWE-bench Verified/Pro-v1/Pro-v2, and the recipe also improves Qwen3.5-9B from 56.2%/31.9%/48.8% to 65.7%/39.6%/70.2% on Verified/Pro-v1/Pro-v2. Controlled comparisons show that both curation and test strengthening improve held-out performance, although stronger tests reduce apparent training-task mastery. Arctic-SWE provides a documented starting point for studying better algorithms, data and environments for asynchronous agent RL.

[283] CasePlay: Self-Play Reinforcement Learning from Case Reports for Medical Reasoning cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Hao Wang, Zihan Wang, Kai Wu, Jian Yao, Yiwen Ye

TL;DR: CasePlay 从临床病例报告构造医疗推理自博弈训练信号，以病例知识点引导提问并用量规同时评估答案与问题质量；七个医学基准上优于自博弈基线，较 SFT 热启动模型平均提升 3.1 分，LiveClin 提升 6.3 分。

Details

Motivation: 临床推理强化学习通常依赖专家标注问题或成本较高的合成数据，而病例报告包含从初始表现到治疗决策的高质量临床过程。既有自博弈容易反复围绕少数显著线索提问，也可能生成难度合适但浅显或设计不佳的问题。

Result: CasePlay 包含知识条件提问生成器和量规评审推理器：前者将问题锚定在病例特定知识点上，扩大对来源报告证据的覆盖；后者除答案准确性外，还评估线索整合、推理深度和选项质量，以促使提问更适合训练推理器。七个医学相关基准实验中，CasePlay 优于已有自博弈基线；相较 SFT 热启动模型，平均提高 3.1 分，其中 LiveClin 提高 6.3 分。

Insight: 未标注病例文献可以转化为持续强化临床推理的训练资源，但自博弈的质量取决于问题是否覆盖多样证据，以及难度是否与推理深度匹配。摘要未报告各基准分项结果、成本或病例来源覆盖范围。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a promising way to improve the clinical reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs), but current pipelines often rely on expert-labeled questions or costly synthetic-data generation. Meanwhile, the medical literature offers a wealth of high-quality unlabeled documents, including clinical case reports that trace the full clinical course from initial presentation to final treatment decisions. We study whether document-grounded self-play can convert these reports into effective RL training signals. We identify two challenges that limit existing self-play methods in this setting: knowledge-point fixation}, where the proposer repeatedly asks about a narrow set of salient clues in a source report, and difficulty-quality mismatch, where appropriately difficult questions may still be poorly formed or shallow, limiting their value for reasoner training. To address these challenges, we propose CasePlay, a self-play framework with two key components: (a) a Knowledge-Conditioned Proposer, which anchors question generation to case-specific knowledge points so that questions draw on a broader range of evidence from the source report; and (b) a Rubric-Judge Reasoner, which augments answer-accuracy feedback with rubric-based quality feedback on clue integration, reasoning depth, and option quality, guiding the proposer toward reasoning-intensive questions that better support reasoner training. Extensive experiments across seven medically related benchmarks demonstrate that CasePlay outperforms existing self-play baselines and improves the SFT warm-start model by 3.1 points on average, highlighted by a 6.3-point gain on LiveClin. This approach offers an effective path toward continually improving medical reasoning ability through self-play RL.

[284] Beyond the Teacher: Understanding and Preserving Distillation Overshoot in Agentic On-Policy Distillation cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Jike Zhong, Ming Li, Yuxiang Lai, Xi Xiao, Sheng Zhang

TL;DR: SPOD 针对 on-policy 蒸馏中学生早期超过教师、随后因教师抑制学生正确选择而退化的 overshoot 现象，选择性屏蔽这类冲突监督并设置软概率下限；三个智能体基准中最终成功率最高提升 15.2 个百分点，且比教师高至 20.0 个百分点。

Details

Motivation: On-policy distillation 让智能体沿自身轨迹接受更强教师监督。作者发现多轮任务中，起初较弱的学生可能在训练中超过教师，继续蒸馏却又回退；原因可能是教师修复学生错误的同时，也磨损教师不认可但实际成功的学生决策。

Result: 作者将早期学生超越教师、后续性能退化称为 distillation overshoot，并分析修复弱决策与侵蚀成功决策这两种竞争效应。Success-Preserving On-Policy Distillation（SPOD）对学生成功但与教师指导冲突的选择，选择性屏蔽教师监督并加入软概率下限，以减缓侵蚀，同时保留其他位置的教师引导。该方法只需二元 episode 成功标记及蒸馏过程已有模型概率。在两个模型家族、三个智能体基准的六种设置中，SPOD 均优于普通 OPD 和所测变体，最终成功率最高提高 15.2 个百分点、超过教师最高 20.0 个百分点；六种设置的最终检查点都超过普通 OPD 最佳中间检查点。

Insight: 教师并非对所有成功学生决策都更好，持续蒸馏可能把教师不偏好的有效行为消除；仅对成功冲突决策保护可保留并继续扩大超教师收益。摘要未给出模型规模及各任务的具体收益。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains agents on their own trajectories using supervision from a stronger teacher. We uncover a counterintuitive phenomenon in multi-turn agentic tasks: a smaller, initially weaker student can substantially outperform its teacher during training, only to regress as distillation continues. We term this phenomenon distillation overshoot. Through decision- and task-level analyses, we trace overshoot to two competing effects of OPD: repairing weak student decisions and eroding successful student choices that the teacher disfavors. Early in training, repair outpaces erosion, allowing the student to combine the teacher’s corrections with its own strengths and surpass the teacher. As training continues, erosion overtakes repair, causing these gains to vanish. Motivated by this finding, we propose Success-Preserving On-Policy Distillation (SPOD), which selectively masks conflicting teacher supervision on successful student choices and introduces a soft probability floor to counteract their erosion, while retaining teacher guidance elsewhere. SPOD requires only binary episode success and model probabilities already available during OPD. Across two model families and three agentic benchmarks, SPOD consistently outperforms ordinary OPD and evaluated variants, improving final success by up to 15.2 percentage points and surpassing the teacher by up to 20.0 points. Moreover, SPOD’s final checkpoints outperform even ordinary OPD’s best intermediate checkpoints in all six settings, demonstrating that beyond-teacher gains can be not only preserved but further extended. Code: https://github.com/Jike338/SPOD

Vahid Jebraeeli, Jonathon Romero, Yijin Wang, Adrian Chan, Jianbang Zhang

TL;DR: 研究指出安全基准分数可能主要反映训练标签采用的“不安全”定义，而非模型检测能力：固定架构下 HarmBench-copyright 在十种护栏训练配置间分数跨度达 0–100，OR-Bench-hard 过度拒答率跨度为 3.4%–56.4%，仅约 0.03% 参数即可改变分数范围。

Details

Motivation: 护栏分类器常被当作判断文本是否不安全的能力模型，但标签实际承载具体操作政策，例如“请求有害内容”与“审核员会拦截”并不相同。论文利用同一批约 5.3 万提示在两种定义下被标注并训练的十个模型配置，审计基准结果是否受政策标签、数据污染和蒸馏软标签影响。

Result: 作者先发现两个过度拒答基准存在训练污染：JailbreakBench-benign 有 88%、OR-Bench-hard 有 82% 出现在训练池，其余报告均去污染。固定架构与优化器时，十种训练臂的基准分数跨度依基准不同：HarmBench-copyright 为 0.99、WildGuard-benign 为 0.043，相差约 23 倍；约 0.03% 参数即可让分数跨越整段范围。HarmBench-copyright 覆盖 0–100，OR-Bench-hard 过度拒答率覆盖 3.4%–56.4%，并随最后监督信号携带的政策定义分处两端。蒸馏学生即使硬标签采用另一政策，教师软标签仍可带入其政策。唯一评估所有模型的验证集准确率与标注者政策一致性相关系数为 0.74，与检测能力仅 0.34。

Insight: 安全基准分数可能测量模型学到哪套标签定义，而不是抽象、统一的安全检测能力；数据污染、种子下限、标注定义和教师软标签来源都应作为评测报告变量。摘要中的极端分数跨度来自特定训练设置，不能外推为所有护栏系统的普遍幅度。

Abstract: A guardrail classifier is reported as if unsafe were a property of text. It is not: it is a property of a policy, and the policy enters the model through its labels. We exploit an accident of an industrial deployment in which the same ~53k prompts were labelled twice, under two operational definitions (“is this a request for harmful content?” and “would a moderator block this?”), and used to train ten guardrail arms sharing architecture, codebase and optimiser family, at two model scales. First, the guardrail’s own training corpus already contained the benchmarks: JailbreakBench-benign is 88% and OR-Bench-hard 82% present in the training pools, two over-refusal benchmarks, the kind a guardrail reports to argue it does not over-block. Everything below is decontaminated. Second, safety benchmarks stratify sharply by how much of their score is decided by the label definition rather than by the model: with architecture and optimiser fixed, the range across the ten arms is 0.99 on HarmBench-copyright and 0.043 on WildGuard-benign, a 23x spread. Third, a benchmark score can be moved across its entire range by 0.03% of the parameters. Across these arms HarmBench-copyright spans 0-100 and OR-Bench-hard over-refusal 3.4-56.4%, and the four arms whose last supervision signal carries a given policy occupy one extreme of both (exact rank p=0.005, or 0.04-0.14 at worst), at unchanged detection capability. For a distilled student the teacher’s soft labels do this even when every hard label carries the other policy, so teacher provenance is an unrecorded confound in any released checkpoint. Fourth, validation accuracy on the one split that grades all twenty arms tracks agreement with the annotator’s policy (rho=+0.74), not detection capability (rho=+0.34). We argue that guardrail evaluations should report contamination, a seed floor and the definition they were graded against as first-class variables.

[286] Trackable Skill Library Lifecycle Management for Agentic Reinforcement Learning cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Xi Zhu, Yuanlin Duan, Changyi Yang, Kai Mei, Riyang Bao

TL;DR: TrackRL 在每个 GRPO 组内对技能独立随机注入，通过同任务组内对比和跨组可靠性加权估计技能的因果效用及模型掌握度，再据证据管理技能从生成、准入到保留、退休或移除；实验中同时改善技能辅助和无技能评测。

Details

Motivation: 智能体强化学习中的技能可能随策略学习出现不同生命周期：有的被模型内化后变冗余，有的仍作为外部脚手架有用，有的则变成有害。现有技能库因多个共同检索技能相互搭便车、任务难度混淆且缺少技能级反事实证据，难以可靠评估各技能贡献。

Result: TrackRL 将每个 GRPO 组内的采样转化为在线随机对照实验：独立随机注入技能，并在同一任务的组内对比，以隔离单项技能贡献；再跨组按可靠性加权累计证据。系统持续追踪技能效用（其作为外部脚手架的因果贡献）和模型掌握度（对应能力已内化多少），并把生命周期管理做成证据门控状态转换，涵盖生成、准入、受保护孵化、保留、退休和移除，同时用软容量上限控制技能库增长。实验显示，TrackRL 在技能辅助和不使用技能的评测中均优于近期技能增强 RL 基线。

Insight: 技能是否仍有价值应分清外部脚手架贡献与模型已内化能力，并用单技能随机对照证据决定生命周期，而非只看共现时的奖励。摘要未报告具体性能数字、技能库规模或控制成本。

Abstract: Skill-augmented agentic RL has emerged as an effective approach to improving LLM agents on long-horizon tasks. Despite this progress, individual skills may follow distinct trajectories as the policy evolves, with some becoming redundant after the model internalizes their capabilities, others remaining valuable as external scaffolding, and still others turning harmful. However, existing skill library systems fail to identify each skill’s true contribution due to free-riding among co-retrieved skills, difficulty confounding across tasks, and the absence of skill-specific counterfactual evidence, which prevents reliable skill lifecycle management. We propose TrackRL, an agentic RL framework where skill tracking drives skill library full lifecycle management. Specifically, within each GRPO group, we turn grouped sampling into online randomized controlled experiments. Independent random injection and within-group contrasts on the same task isolate each skill’s true contribution, and reliability-weighted aggregation accumulates evidence across groups. As evidence accumulates, we continuously track skill utility, which measures the skill’s causal contribution as external scaffolding, and model mastery, which reflects how far the corresponding capability has been internalized. Along this line, we formulate skill lifecycle management as an evidence-gated state-transition process that governs each skill from generation and admission through protected incubation to retention, retirement, or removal, while a soft capacity bound controls library growth. Experiments show that TrackRL outperforms recent skill-augmented RL baselines in both library-assisted and skill-free evaluation, with further analyses revealing how skill value shifts during policy learning and how evidence-driven state transitions shape skill library evolution. Our code is available at https://github.com/xizhu1022/TrackRL.

[287] ATEST: Adaptive Resource-Aware Test-Time Scaling for LLM Inference cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.DC | cs.PFPDF

Mobina Kashaniyan, Ali Jannesari

TL;DR: ATEST 在测试时扩展推理预算时同时考虑额外采样的预期收益和实时 GPU 能耗；在线版无需离线校准即可监控负载并决定停止，在四个 A100 基准上所有问题均未超能耗预算且准确率最高或统计持平，高负载 GSM8K 准确率为 60.0% 且无延期。

Details

Motivation: 测试时扩展通过采样多个答案提升推理，但固定采样数忽略了问题难度和 GPU 争用下能耗变化。作者测得相同四样本查询在负载增加时能耗最多上升 4.1 倍，因此固定预算可能不适应资源动态。

Result: ATEST 联合评估增加样本的预期价值和当前 GPU 成本。默认在线模式 ATEST-Online 无需离线校准，逐步生成样本、估计多数答案稳定性、监测实时 GPU 条件并在线学习单步能耗，以决定何时停止；ATEST-Calibrated 则利用离线准确率和成本模型按问题选择预算，适合负载稳定场景。在 A100 上以 Phi-3-mini 测试四个推理问答数据集并控制变化负载，另测试迁移到 L40S 和 Qwen2.5-3B。四个 A100 数据集上，在线版每题都未超能耗预算，准确率最高或与最高统计持平，并会随负载升高减少采样。高负载 GSM8K 上在线版准确率 60.0%、无延期；校准版为 44.0%、延期率 42.4%。计入离线分析后，在线版相较校准版少用 42 倍 GPU 时间和 48 倍能耗。在线控制在短任务上以更高尾延迟和较低吞吐为代价，换取负载变化下鲁棒性。

Insight: 采样预算应随查询难度和当下硬件负载变化，而不应把静态准确率成本估计套到所有推理时刻。在线成本学习是适应负载的关键消融结果；负载稳定时离线校准仍有竞争力。

Abstract: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves large language model (LLM) reasoning by sampling multiple answers, but fixed sampling budgets ignore both query difficulty and the changing energy cost of inference under GPU contention. We measure up to a 4.1-fold increase in energy for the same four-sample query as GPU load rises. We present ATEST, a resource-aware TTS framework that jointly considers the expected value of additional samples and their current GPU cost. ATEST-Online, its default mode, requires no offline calibration: it incrementally generates samples, estimates the stability of the plurality answer, monitors live GPU conditions, and learns step energy cost online to decide when to stop. ATEST-Calibrated instead selects a per-query budget using offline accuracy and cost models, favoring deployments with stable loads. We evaluate both modes on four reasoning and question-answering datasets using Phi-3-mini on an NVIDIA A100 under controlled varying load, and test transfer to an NVIDIA L40S and Qwen2.5-3B. Across the four A100 datasets, ATEST-Online answers every query without exceeding the energy budget, while achieving the highest or statistically tied accuracy and reducing sampling as load increases. On GSM8K at high load, it achieves 60.0% accuracy with no deferrals, versus 44.0% accuracy and 42.4% deferrals for ATEST-Calibrated. Ablations show that online cost learning drives adaptation to load. Including offline profiling, ATEST-Online uses 42 times less GPU time and 48 times less energy than ATEST-Calibrated for the evaluated workload. Online control trades higher tail latency and lower throughput on short tasks for robustness under varying load; offline calibration remains competitive under stable conditions.

[288] Finite Interaction Lens: Structured Precision Sharing for Vision-Language Models cs.LG | cs.CVPDF

Nozomu Fujisawa

TL;DR: Finite Interaction Lens（FIL）在有限干预评估中提高单干预组件数值精度，并在联合候选中复用这些数值贡献，同时保留混合残差和非线性路径；被测 Qwen3-VL-4B 上，合成族及两组四图 COCO 研究的交互误差分别降低 94.4%、99.85% 和 99.35%，但作者说明其实际价值取决于下游任务是否需要这类精度。

Details

Motivation: 要判断 VLM 中两种视觉干预是否相互作用，需比较它们联合和单独的四种输出；交互差可能很小，容易被舍入误差淹没。

Result: FIL 是评估有限干预族的混合精度方法。在选定线性投影处，它将各候选输入分为原生状态、两项单独干预分量和全维混合残差；单独分量用更高精度投影，并在联合候选中复用相同数值贡献，同时保留全部混合残差和非线性轨迹。作者推导局部抵消恒等式及平滑非线性下误差传播的条件界。在 Qwen3-VL-4B 的一个 MLP 上，相较同名义 BF16 乘积预算、但独立计算每个联合候选的控制，FIL 在 16 个合成族上交互 MSE 降低 94.4%，两项独立四图 COCO 研究分别降低 99.85% 和 99.35%；每项研究的绝对增益主要来自一张图。对所有候选使用更高精度多乘积 BF16 在相近总查询时间下总体误差更低；单乘积 BF16 已能恢复测试的两个候选选择任务中的参考选择。

Insight: 固定名义精度预算时，复用单干预计算可明显提高交互量测的数值保真度；但更高精度的全候选计算可能有更低总体误差，且已有选择任务不一定需要额外精度。论文将结果限定在开发输入，未证明一般任务收益。

Abstract: Identifying which visual interventions interact in a vision-language model requires comparing their joint and separate effects. The resulting four-output difference can be small enough for rounding error to obscure it. We introduce the Finite Interaction Lens (FIL), a mixed-precision method for evaluating finite intervention families. At each selected linear projection, FIL decomposes each candidate’s input into a native state, two single-intervention components, and a full-dimensional mixed residual. It projects the single-intervention components at higher precision and reuses the same numerical contributions in the joint candidates, while retaining every mixed residual and nonlinear trajectory. We derive a local cancellation identity and a conditional bound on error propagation through a smooth nonlinearity. In one MLP of Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, FIL reduces final interaction MSE by 94.4% on 16 synthetic families and by 99.85% and 99.35% in two separate four-image COCO studies, relative to a control that has the same nominal BF16-product budget and higher-precision single interventions but projects each joint candidate independently. One image accounts for most of the absolute gain in each COCO study. Higher-accuracy multi-product BF16 arithmetic on all candidates gives lower aggregate error at similar total query times. Single-product BF16 already recovers the reference choices in both candidate-selection tasks we tested. On these development inputs, FIL improves interaction fidelity at a fixed nominal precision budget. Its practical value depends on a task that needs the extra fidelity.

[289] Curriculum Learning Teaches LLMs Long-Horizon Implicit Reasoning, Up To A Limit cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Jimson Huang, Maxwell Nickell, Ruowang Zhang, Abulhair Saparov

TL;DR: 课程学习按词汇规模和前瞻步数逐渐增加隐式推理难度；在匹配计算量下，Qwen3-0.6B 对最多需向前搜索 256 步的问题准确率达到 98%，无课程训练为 45%，但持续微调呈饱和趋势，表明隐式推理深度存在学习上限。

Details

Motivation: LLM 的显式思维链会把中间步骤写成 token，但长时任务上即使强推理模型也会突然失效。隐式推理可让模型在单次前向中提前搜索下一步，减少错误路径和回溯；既有研究显示其深度浅且单纯扩大规模无法解决，论文研究渐进式课程能否提升该深度。

Result: 作者通过逐步增加词汇规模和 lookahead（判断正确下一步所需向前搜索的步数）微调模型。在相同计算量下，课程训练能达到无课程训练无法达到的前瞻深度。Qwen3-0.6B 在 lookahead 最多 256 的问题上，课程训练准确率为 98%，无课程为 45%。继续微调的进步速度按饱和指数减缓，提示可学习隐式推理深度有内在上限；更大的模型拟合上限更高，预训练模型微调远快于从头训练，过大的课程步长会使进展停滞。合成任务能力还迁移至 11 个自然语言推理基准，在匹配计算量下超过无课程训练。

Insight: 逐步扩展模型需隐式预演的搜索范围，可以提高其单步规划深度，但并未消除能力上限；模型规模、预训练和课程步幅都会影响最终可达范围。摘要未给各自然语言基准具体成绩或拟合上限值。

Abstract: LLMs “reason” by externalizing intermediate steps as tokens through chain-of-thought (CoT), yet even frontier reasoning models hit abrupt performance cliffs on long-horizon tasks. Implicit reasoning (reasoning within a single forward pass) is useful during CoT generation, as the model can “search ahead” to decide the correct next move without explicit search. Models with weak implicit reasoning are more likely to commit to wrong paths and must attempt to recover via backtracking, while models with strong implicit reasoning identify the correct proof strategy directly, shortening the CoT. However, prior work shows LLMs struggle to reason implicitly beyond shallow depths, with no relief from scale. We investigate whether curriculum learning can extend this depth by fine-tuning on examples with progressively increasing vocabulary size and lookahead (the number of steps a model must search ahead to identify the correct next move). At matched compute, curriculum-trained models achieve lookaheads where no-curriculum training fails. Qwen3-0.6B reaches 98% accuracy on problems with lookahead up to 256 with curriculum, compared to 45% without. However, progress slows as fine-tuning continues, following a saturating exponential that suggests a maximum intrinsic lookahead to which models can learn to reason implicitly. Larger models reach higher fitted ceilings, fine-tuning pretrained models far outpaces training from scratch, and curriculum step sizes that are too large stall progression. Finally, the capability acquired on synthetic data transfers to natural language reasoning, with curriculum-trained models outperforming models trained without curriculum at matched compute on 11 natural language reasoning benchmarks.

[290] Computation, Not Memory: Chain-of-Thought and State Tracking in LLM Agents cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Pedram Mouseli, Massieh Moayedi

TL;DR: 在需要跟踪文件锁状态的受控任务中，Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3.5-9B 的规则遵循收益主要来自每次行动前新生成的推理；把旧推理保留在上下文帮助有限，甚至会让模型服从来自不同状态历史的错误推理。

Details

Motivation: 智能体常先生成推理再行动，监控推理文本是否能预测动作取决于推理与状态跟踪的关系。论文设计一个文件系统任务：背景事件只告知哪个锁被切换、不告知新值，智能体必须根据历史重建当前锁状态才能安全移动文件。

Result: 作者用 Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3.5-9B 分离考察行动前生成推理与在提示中保留历史推理的作用。大部分锁违规命令减少来自每次行动时当下生成推理；保留更早推理对遵循规则帮助很小，但能帮助其中一个模型完成任务。收益依赖推理内容：填充文本、针对其他历史生成的推理以及准确状态表都不能复现效果；若给模型一段仅有一个锁值不同的错误历史推理，它会采纳该推理，即使与自身历史冲突。没有显式推理时，线性探针能从激活中恢复状态，准确率与从文本记录中训练的分类器相近，但状态解码准确度无法预测干预是否改变动作。

Insight: 在此设置中，规则遵循更依赖行动前逐步生成的推理，而不是把旧推理当作可靠状态记忆；可解码的内部状态也不等于能预测或控制模型行为。结论限于单一受控文件锁任务，摘要未证明其对现实智能体的普遍性。

Abstract: Language-model agents often reason before they act, and the value of monitoring that reasoning depends on how it relates to their actions. We ask how an agent’s actions depend on its reasoning when the correct action depends on a changing state. In a small file-system task, background events announce which file’s lock has been toggled but not its new value. The agent therefore has to reconstruct the current locks from its history before it can move files safely. With Qwen3-8B and Qwen3.5-9B, we separate two roles of reasoning: generating it before each action, and retaining earlier reasoning in the prompt. Most of the reduction in lock-violating commands comes from reasoning written at the moment of action. Retaining earlier reasoning adds little to rule-following, although it helps one model complete the task. The benefit depends on what the reasoning says. Filler text, reasoning written for another history and an accurate table of the state do not reproduce it. When we give the agent reasoning written for a history that differs in one lock value, the agent acts on that reasoning even against its own history. Without reasoning, linear probes recover the state from the model’s activations about as well as a text classifier recovers it from the transcript. However, decoding accuracy does not predict which interventions change the agent’s actions. In this setting, the benefit of reasoning for rule-following comes mainly from generating it at each step. The state that can be decoded without reasoning is a limited guide to how the agent acts.

[291] Keep the Lineages Alive: Diversity-Preserving SMC for Diffusion LLM Decoding cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CL | stat.AP | stat.MLPDF

Minoo Ahmadi, Seyedarmin Azizi, Mehdi Kamal, Massoud Pedram

TL;DR: LP-SMC 用带输入权重下限的 Chopthin 重采样，在扩散语言模型的序贯蒙特卡洛解码中保留低权重但仍可能成功的推理谱系；两种基座模型的数学推理和代码任务上，oracle coverage 全部提高 1.8–25.6 分，统一奖励模型选择器下 12 种设置中 11 种端到端准确率提高。

Details

Motivation: 推理时 SMC 可按奖励重采样扩散语言模型的部分生成，以改善准确率，但重采样既需聚焦有希望候选，也要保留不同推理路径。多项式重采样可能复制高权重粒子、丢弃早期低权重但后来能答对的谱系；有效样本量 ESS 可能在谱系已经消失时仍显示为最大值。

Result: Lineage-Preserving SMC（LP-SMC）将 Chopthin 重采样与输入权重下限结合。Chopthin 不再把权重完全均等化，而限制返回权重最大值与最小值的比例并将不等权重继续传递；下限则限制权重在重采样前可低于最大值多少，从而让早期低权重谱系保有恢复机会。两种基座模型的数学推理和代码基准中，oracle coverage（至少有一个正确粒子的题目比例）在每种设置提高 1.8–25.6 个百分点；用共同奖励模型选择器计算端到端准确率时，12 种设置有 11 种提高，LLaDA-1.5 上最高提高 7.9 点，Dream-7B 上最高提高 18.3 点。外部奖励模型下 coverage 增益仍存在。

Insight: 推理时搜索不能只追踪当前奖励最高的路径；限制权重过度集中可保留可能后来恢复的推理谱系，而且多样性保留与奖励引导分别贡献收益。摘要未给出各基准逐项数值或额外采样成本。

Abstract: Inference-time sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) decoding can improve the reasoning accuracy of masked diffusion language models (diffusion LLMs) without post-training by resampling a population of partial generations according to a reward. Its effectiveness therefore depends on the resampling step, which must concentrate computation on promising candidates while retaining enough diversity to explore alternative reasoning paths. The reward can be internal, the decoder’s own confidence on the committed prefix, or external, a process reward model scoring that prefix. Under either reward, multinomial resampling can disrupt this balance by duplicating high-weight particles and discarding lineages that may still reach a correct solution. The effective sample size (ESS) does not register this loss: multinomial resampling resets it to its maximum even as distinct lineages disappear. To retain such lineages, we introduce lineage-preserving SMC (LP-SMC), which combines Chopthin resampling with an input weight floor. Instead of equalizing weights, Chopthin bounds the ratio between the largest and smallest weights it returns and carries the unequal weights forward. The floor limits how far below the maximum a weight may fall before resampling so that lineages with low early weight keep a chance to recover. Across mathematical-reasoning and code-generation benchmarks on two base models, LP-SMC raises oracle coverage, the fraction of problems with at least one correct particle, in every setting, by 1.8 to 25.6 points, and raises end-to-end accuracy under a common reward-model selector in eleven of twelve settings, by up to 7.9 points on LLaDA-1.5 and 18.3 on Dream-7B. The coverage gain persists under the external reward model, which suggests that diversity-preserving resampling and the guidance signal contribute separately to inference-time search.

[292] Correctness-Dependent Asymmetric Target Distributions for Self-Distillation Policy Optimization cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Suwan Yoon, Seongryong Jung, Changhee Lee

TL;DR: APSD 按 rollout 正误构造非对称自蒸馏目标：对正确轨迹在学生与自教师分布间插值以保留成功行为，对错误轨迹外推以加强纠正；在多个 Qwen3 规模上，平均用 2.6 倍更少训练步数即可匹配 SDPO。

Details

Motivation: 自蒸馏策略优化能通过反馈条件化自教师提供密集 token 监督，但直接匹配自教师可能破坏正确 rollout 中已有的成功行为，同时对错误 rollout 的纠正又不够强。论文希望按结果正确性分别设置监督强度。

Result: Asymmetric Policy Optimization via Self-Distillation（APSD）根据 rollout 正误，将学生与自教师分布混合形成不同目标：正确 rollout 使用插值保留学生的有效行为；错误 rollout 则外推到自教师分布之外以加强纠正。论文从散度分解、反向 KL 重心几何和梯度分析解释方法，并指出梯度需通过依赖学生分布的目标传播。在可验证奖励强化学习和丰富反馈设置下，APSD 整体表现优于 RL 与自蒸馏基线；跨 Qwen3 多个模型规模，平均训练步数约为 SDPO 的 1/2.6，即减少约 2.6 倍后达到相当表现。

Insight: 成功轨迹与失败轨迹不应被同一种自教师匹配目标处理；保留前者、强化纠正后者有助于减少学习过程中的能力破坏。摘要未报告各规模详细指标及训练步数外的计算成本。

Abstract: Self-distillation policy optimization provides dense token-level supervision for LLM post-training through feedback-conditioned self-teachers. However, directly matching the self-teacher can disrupt successful behaviors on correct rollouts while providing insufficient correction on incorrect ones. We propose Asymmetric Policy Optimization via Self-Distillation (APSD), which constructs correctness-dependent targets by mixing student and self-teacher distributions: interpolation preserves successful behaviors on correct rollouts, while extrapolation beyond the self-teacher strengthens correction on incorrect ones. We analyze APSD through divergence decomposition, reverse-KL barycentric geometry, and gradient analysis, highlighting the importance of gradient flow through student-dependent targets. Experiments under reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards and rich feedback show that APSD achieves strong overall performance against reinforcement-learning and self-distillation baselines and matches SDPO performance with 2.6x fewer training steps on average across Qwen3 model scales.

[293] Intra-Rubric Reward Divergence: Mitigating Rubric Hacking through Latent Dimension Recovery and Balancing cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Jianqiang Xia, Han Xu, Dianxi Shi

TL;DR: FRDA 让生成结果在各 rubric 子维度内分别竞争以缓解维度权重失衡，RSDC 则从整体偏好信号中恢复未明确写出的评价维度以补全覆盖；聊天、科学和医疗实验中，FRDA 训练更稳定，RSDC 通常优于单奖励和朴素多奖励聚合。

Details

Motivation: 基于 rubric 的强化学习会出现 rubric hacking。作者把评分拆成子维度后发现，总分提高时某些子维度得分反而系统性下降，说明模型可能牺牲特定质量方面来优化聚合目标；原因包括被重点覆盖的维度权重失衡，以及 rubric 缺少真实质量中的某些维度。

Result: 论文观察到 Intra-Rubric Reward Divergence，即 rubric 总分上涨时部分子维度分数下降。为缓解维度失衡，Fair-Race Dimension Aggregation（FRDA）让生成结果在每个维度分别竞争；为缓解维度缺失，Residual Semantic Dimension Completion（RSDC）从整体偏好信号中挖掘隐含评价维度以补全 rubric。聊天、科学和医疗领域实验显示，FRDA 减少 rubric hacking 并带来更稳定的提升；RSDC 优于单奖励训练和朴素多奖励聚合，通常产生质量更高的回答。

Insight: rubric 总分可能掩盖某些质量维度被牺牲，既要避免少数高权重维度支配训练，也要检查 rubric 是否遗漏整体偏好中的隐含标准。摘要未给出各领域具体数值或子维度诊断成本。

Abstract: Rubric hacking limits both performance and training robustness in rubric-based reinforcement learning. By decomposing rubrics into sub-dimensions, we reveal the Intra-Rubric Reward Divergence: as the total rubric score increases, certain sub-dimension scores systematically decrease, suggesting the model sacrifices specific quality aspects to optimize the aggregated objective. From the sub-dimension perspective, we observe two phenomena: (1) dimension imbalance, causing the policy to favor heavily covered dimensions; (2) dimension absence, leading to a systematic gap between rewards and true quality. To mitigate these issues, we propose Fair-Race Dimension Aggregation (FRDA), which has generations compete within each dimension separately to mitigate rubric imbalance, and Residual Semantic Dimension Completion (RSDC), which mines evaluation dimensions implicitly encoded in a holistic preference signal to complete rubric coverage. Experiments in chat, science, and medical domains indicate that FRDA mitigates rubric hacking with more stable improvements, while RSDC outperforms both single-reward training and naive multi-reward aggregation, yielding generally higher-quality responses.

[294] CAVA: Complementary-Label-Aware Data Valuation cs.LG | cs.CVPDF

Tan-Ha Mai, Hsuan-Tien Lin, Vu Nguyen

TL;DR: CAVA 将互补标签学习中的数据估值按“该样本不是类别 c”这一标签语义重新建模，通过互补标签成本和标签间隔稳定检测错标；在合成及人工标注基准上，能近乎完美分离对角噪声，并用部分干净验证数据改善所有测试的 CLL 目标。

Details

Motivation: 互补标签学习用“该样本不属于类别 c”的标签训练分类器，众包标注者或 VLM 可较低成本提供此类标签；但一旦错误地把真类标为互补类，模型就会被明确训练去压制正确答案。直接迁移最优传输数据估值还会混淆训练集互补标签与验证集正类标签的语义。

Result: 作者证明，直接迁移的 OT 标签组会变成依噪声率变化的混合：只有噪声足够高时分数才有信息，在 M 类问题的交叉率 1/M 处失去信息，低于此率时排序反转，而实际 CLL 标注往往位于低噪声区。CAVA 引入互补标签成本和标签间隔，以隔离每个互补标签对传输势的贡献，使间隔在不同噪声率下方向一致；它用无需调参的闭式精度阈值检测对角噪声，并将检测样本回收为普通类别监督。合成及人工标注基准上，CAVA 几乎完美区分对角噪声，而直接迁移 OT 估值还不如随机；仅用部分干净验证数据，也能提升所有被评 CLL 目标。

Insight: 数据估值必须尊重互补标签和普通标签的相反语义，否则低噪声时可能反转样本价值排序。显式建模该语义后，错误互补标注还可转为常规正类监督。摘要未给出各数据集具体噪声率或分数。

Abstract: Complementary-label learning (CLL) trains a classifier from labels that name a class an instance does not belong to. Such labels are cheap to collect from crowdworkers or vision-language models (VLMs), making them attractive for large-scale annotation. However, both sources can mistakenly assign the true class as the complementary label. Such annotation errors are particularly harmful in CLL because the model is explicitly trained to suppress the correct answer. Optimal transport (OT) data valuation identifies harmful samples by comparing training data with a clean validation set, but transferring it directly to CLL creates a semantic mismatch: label $c$ means not class $c$ in the training but class $c$ in the validation. We show that this makes the OT label groups noisy mixtures whose behavior depends on the noise rate. The transferred score is informative only at sufficiently high noise, becomes uninformative at the crossover rate $1/M$ for $M$ classes, and reverses below it, where practical CLL annotation typically operates. We propose CAVA, which introduces a complementary label cost and a label margin that isolates the contribution of each complementary label to the transport potential. The margin keeps a consistent direction across noise rates, detects diagonal noise with a parameter-free threshold of closed-form precision, and allows detected samples to be recycled as ordinary-label supervision. On synthetic and human-annotated benchmarks, CAVA separates diagonal noise almost perfectly where directly transferred OT valuation performs worse than random. With only a fraction of the clean validation data, it also improves every CLL objective we evaluate, showing that OT-based valuation becomes reliable once the semantics of complementary supervision are modeled explicitly.

[295] recAMPLIFY: Large-Scale Pretraining of Recursive Protein Language Models cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Saurav Jha, Qianli Liao, Robert Vernon, Sarath Chandar, Quentin Fournier

TL;DR: recAMPLIFY 将权重共享 Transformer 递归预训练用于掩码蛋白语言模型，以 155M 独立参数和与 AMPLIFY-350M 相同的 2T token 训练；参数少 56%，CASP 接触恢复更好，四项监督任务中三项提升，折叠准确率提高 22.5%。

Details

Motivation: 蛋白质语言模型可用于蛋白注释和突变效应预测，但进步主要依赖扩大模型和数据，成本高且易记忆。自回归语言模型的测试时扩展方法难直接迁移到掩码编码器，因为其没有生成循环，氨基酸也不以自然语言推理表达。

Result: recAMPLIFY 将递归预训练应用于掩码蛋白模型，以权重共享 Transformer 核心在可调整循环次数下迭代细化残基对齐隐藏状态。模型有 155M 独立参数，以同 AMPLIFY-350M 相同的 2T token 训练；尽管参数少 56%，CASP 接触恢复更好，四项监督任务中的三项提升，折叠准确率增加 22.5%。由于最佳递归深度因任务和实验而异，作者提出 Gated Mixture Recurrence（GMR），按概率混合递归各轮的隐藏状态，并以学习残差门控制每轮更新幅度。GMR 在 recAMPLIFY 上将期望层深最多降低 37%，但不同任务准确率权衡不一；机制分析显示门控可在训练深度之外控制循环稳定性，停止深度也与生物属性相关。

Insight: 对掩码蛋白模型，重复细化残基表示提供测试时计算扩展途径；递归次数应适应任务，门控有助于控制更深循环的稳定性。摘要指出 GMR 减少深度时存在任务相关的准确率权衡，未给出各任务完整数值。

Abstract: Protein language models (pLMs) are powerful tools for protein annotation and mutation-effect prediction, but progress has largely depended on scaling model size and data, making them expensive and prone to memorization. Test-time scaling offers a complementary path, but methods developed for autoregressive LLMs do not transfer directly: masked encoders lack a generation loop, and amino acids do not verbalize in a reasoning language. Instead, we adapt recursive pretraining to masked pLMs, where a weight-tied Transformer core refines residue-aligned hidden states over an adjustable number of cycles. We instantiate this recipe as recAMPLIFY, a pLM with 155M unique parameters trained on the same 2T tokens as AMPLIFY-350M. Despite 56% fewer parameters, it improves CASP contact recovery and three out of four supervised tasks, notably raising fold accuracy by 22.5%. Because optimal depth for recAMPLIFY varies across tasks and assays, we then introduce Gated Mixture Recurrence (GMR), a framework that decodes each protein from a probability-weighted mixture of hidden states visited during recursion. GMR employs a learned residual gate at scalar, low-rank, or per-dimension resolution to control how much of each cycle’s proposed update is accepted into the state. This unifies halting and gating into a single adaptive computation objective while recovering PonderNet-style halting as a special case without gates. Layered on top of recAMPLIFY, GMR further reduces expected layer depth by up to 37%, although the accuracy trade-off varies by task. Mechanistic analyses show that residual gating controls recurrence stability beyond the trained depth and that halt depth tracks biological properties.

Keshigeyan Chandrasegaran, Yue Zhao, Armin W. Thomas, Ehsan Adeli, Jiajun Wu

Details

Motivation: 现代文生图系统通常依赖互联网规模语言预训练。论文研究强文本条件图像生成是否必须以语言模型预训练为前提。

Insight: 在所比模型和数据设置下，图文联合从头训练已可获得强文生图结果，纯文本语言预训练并非必要前置步骤；图像描述也可通过 I2T 监督加入。摘要未说明 gFD 的计算细节或更多规模比较。

Abstract: Modern text-to-image (T2I) systems use internet-scale language pretraining for text-conditioned image generation. We ask whether language pretraining is necessary for strong T2I generation. We introduce Halcyon, a family of early-fusion multimodal autoregressive models pretrained entirely from scratch on GPIC, a dataset of 100M image-text pairs. Halcyon-0.52B outperforms LlamaGen-XL/8 (48.0 vs. 63.3 gFD) with 18.2$\times$ less pretraining compute. Further, Halcyon-1.6B outperforms JiT-T2I-XXL/8++ (35.3 vs. 41.0 gFD) with 275$\times$ less pretraining compute. Controlled experiments show that text-only pretraining does not improve T2I generation. Halcyon also learns image captioning by replacing caption dropout with I2T supervision, maintaining competitive T2I generation quality under the same pretraining budget. We show that strong T2I systems can be trained from scratch without internet-scale language pretraining. Code and models are available at https://cs.stanford.edu/~keshik/halcyon

Weiyi Kong, Shiyang Lai, Jinghua Piao, James Evans

TL;DR: 多模型语言系统即使不更新权重，也会在 200–1,000 轮闭环交互中出现语义坍缩：表达词汇看似不同，语义表示却逐步趋同；测试的 13 类干预均未能可靠恢复多样性。

Details

Motivation: 多智能体语言模型越来越多地用于自主生成，这重新引出闭环交互能否持续产生新内容的问题。论文关注不同模型组成的系统是否会在反复交互中保持语义探索，还是逐渐收敛到狭窄表达。

Result: 作者观察到多模型系统出现系统性语义表示趋同，尽管表面词汇仍有变化，过程不需要重新训练或更新模型权重。该模式跨模型家族并持续 200 至 1,000 轮。研究测试了 13 种干预实现，覆盖解码参数、提示设计、智能体组成、激活工程和强化学习，但均不能可靠恢复语义多样性。机制分析认为，这种坍缩不完全能由研究所检验的对齐或从众偏差解释，而与自回归生成的内在性质相符。

Insight: 在封闭的多轮生成环路中，表面语言多样不代表语义探索仍然多样，简单调整提示、采样或智能体组成也未必能解决收敛。摘要未给出语义坍缩的量化度量及各干预的具体效果。

Abstract: Whether machines can originate novel content has been debated for nearly two centuries, from Lovelace’s assertion that no engine can “originate anything” to Turing’s question of whether a machine can amplify ideas brought in from outside. Interacting multi-LLM systems, increasingly deployed for autonomous generation, reopen this question empirically. Here we show that such systems exhibit semantic collapse, systematic convergence in semantic representations despite apparent lexical variation, with no retraining or weight updates. The pattern holds across model families and over 200 to 1,000 rounds. Thirteen intervention implementations tested, spanning decoding parameters, prompt design, agent composition, activation engineering, and reinforcement learning, did not reliably restore semantic diversity. Mechanistic analyses suggest that semantic collapse is not solely attributable to the alignment or conformity biases examined here, but is consistent with intrinsic properties of autoregressive generation. Our results point to persistent constraints on the ability of multi-LLM systems to sustain open-ended exploration in closed-loop settings.

[298] Context-Aware RGB-Thermal-Radar Obstacle Perception for Resource-Constrained ASVs cs.RO | cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

Pranav Kedia, Edwin Redhead, Heiko Hamann

TL;DR: 该系统为自主水面艇融合 RGB、长波红外、毫米波雷达和惯性上下文，并输出带传感器状态的方位扇区障碍概率；24 段、351 米闭环湖面试验覆盖昼昏夜，低照留出集融合 AP 为 0.869，优于规则融合与门控融合，但低于可用时的 RGB 单模态。

Details

Motivation: 小型自主水面艇的视觉障碍感知会受到反光和眩光干扰，船体运动还会改变水线位置，夜间则可能失去主要 RGB 传感器。论文希望让系统在多传感器质量随环境变化时仍提供可用导航输入，而不是只追求静态融合准确率。

Result: 系统结合 RGB、长波红外图像、FMCW 毫米波雷达和惯性上下文，并向导航控制器提供校准后的障碍概率、雷达距离及传感器状态，区分传感器掉线与有效无障碍观测。新多模态湖面数据上进行 24 段闭环试点，包含 16 段白天、4 段黄昏和 4 段夜间，航程 351 米；夜间 RGB 不可用时仅依靠红外和雷达行驶。八段低照留出记录中，校准融合模型 AP 为 0.869、ECE 为 0.108；规则融合 AP 为 0.673，门控融合为 0.620，RGB 单独为 0.903。结果体现权衡：RGB 可用时排名最高，RGB 失效时多模态融合仍能提供导航输入。

Insight: 多模态系统的价值不仅是可用时提高精度，也在主要模态失效时维持可校准的可用感知。证据是受控规模的湖面试点，摘要未报告多日任务、误报警率或传感器失效分项。

Abstract: Reliable obstacle perception is challenging for small autonomous surface vessels (ASVs): reflections and glare confound visible-light cameras, vessel motion shifts the apparent waterline, and darkness removes the dominant sensing modality altogether. Rather than treating multimodal fusion as a static accuracy gain, we propose a context-aware architecture that combines RGB and long-wave infrared (LWIR) imagery, frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) mmWave radar, and inertial context. A bearing-sector interface provides the navigation controller with calibrated obstacle probabilities, radar ranges, and sensor status. It also distinguishes sensor dropout from a valid observation with no detected obstacle. Using new multimodal lake recordings, we deployed the pipeline in a 24-leg closed-loop pilot under uncontrolled lake conditions (16 day, 4 dusk, and 4 night; 351 m), including night legs in which RGB was unusable and the vessel drove on LWIR and radar evidence alone. On eight held-out low-light recordings, the calibrated fusion model achieved average precision (AP) 0.869 and expected calibration error 0.108, compared with AP 0.673 for rule-based fusion, 0.620 for gated fusion, and 0.903 for RGB alone. Our results expose a central tradeoff: RGB ranks best when usable, whereas fusion preserves a navigation input when RGB fails. This work is a step toward perception that remains usable and degrades predictably across multi-day ASV missions.

[299] InJePA: Intention-First Latent Planning with Coupled JEPA World Models for Visual Navigation cs.RO | cs.CV | cs.LGPDF

Siming Zhou, Bowen Ma, Ruiran Du, Pengcheng Zheng, Sheng Zheng

TL;DR: InJePA 将导航规划对象从完整动作序列改为潜在意图：目标条件 JEPA 生成意图，动作条件 JEPA 预测未来状态，预测后果再反馈到同一候选的下一步意图与动作推断；Habitat MP3D 图像目标闭环导航显示该意图引导方式有效。

Details

Motivation: 视觉导航需结合环境动态预测进行目标导向规划。代表性世界模型方法先提出完整动作候选，再预测其后果以选择或更新搜索，因此预测只负责评估动作，较少逐步指导候选本身如何构造。

Result: InJePA 提出以潜在状态为中心的意图优先规划。目标条件 JEPA 提出潜在意图，动作条件 JEPA 持续预测未来潜在状态，两者在共享空间中对齐预测表征。在每条候选计划内，预测后果会反馈到下一步意图提议和动作推断，形成“意图—动作—后果”闭环，使世界模型参与逐步构造候选，而非只在候选完成后评价。Habitat MP3D 闭环图像目标导航实验显示，意图引导的动作生成可有效完成多步导航；不同编码器实验也支持该方法适用于不同视觉表示。

Insight: 潜在意图可作为规划的中心对象，让预测后果直接引导下一步计划生成，扩展世界模型从候选评估到候选构造的作用。摘要未给出导航成功率、与基线的具体差距或复杂场景压力测试。

Abstract: Visual navigation requires goal directed planning informed by predictions of environment dynamics. Representative navigation world model methods propose complete action candidates before predicting consequences for selection or search updates. For each candidate, predictions primarily evaluate proposed actions rather than guide its stepwise construction. To this end, we propose InJepa, an intention first planning paradigm centered on latent states. A goal conditioned JEPA proposes latent intentions, and an action conditioned JEPA continually predicts future latent states. Both operate in a shared latent space to align their predictive representations. Within each candidate, predicted consequences feed into the next intention proposal and action inference, forming a closed loop of intention, action, and consequence. This extends the world model’s role beyond evaluation to leading candidate construction through latent intentions. We evaluate InJepa through closed loop image goal navigation in Habitat MP3D. The results show effective multistep navigation through intention guided action generation and consequence feedback. Experiments across encoders further support applicability across visual representations. These findings support latent intentions as the central planning object and show that world models can directly guide plan construction through coordinated reasoning about intentions and consequences. Code is available at https://github.com/zhuxun132/InJepa.

[300] ChairNav: Cross-Embodiment Pre-training and Personalization for Long-Horizon Wheelchair Navigation cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Junhua Huang, Zhizheng Liu, Honglin He, Xiang Zhang, Bolei Zhou

TL;DR: ChairNav 将通用视觉导航模型通过跨形态预训练、少量轮椅示范中训练和用户干预后训练适配为个性化电动轮椅导航系统；侧向 ADE 降低 18%，平均干预间距从 29.2 米提高到 57.4 米，公里级城市路线中自主行驶时间占 93.4%。

Details

Motivation: 自主电动轮椅的长距离人行道导航对无障碍出行很重要，但现有方法多限于室内地图，或依赖昂贵复杂传感器。视觉导航基础模型和大规模跨形态数据可能让轻量硬件也具备泛化能力。

Result: ChairNav 采用三阶段数据金字塔：先把大规模跨形态数据转换到轮椅领域进行预训练，再用少量轮椅示范中训练消除残余域差，最后根据用户干预后训练以个性化行为。系统部署在带 RGB-D 相机和 NVIDIA Jetson 的商用电动轮椅上。预训练使侧向平均位移误差降低 18%；后训练将用户干预间平均距离由 29.2 米提高到 57.4 米。公里级城市人行道路线中，系统有 93.4% 驾驶时间可自主运行。

Insight: 跨形态数据提供导航先验，小量轮椅演示补足具身域差，部署期用户干预再适配个体偏好；三阶段分别解决不同层次的数据不足。摘要未报告路线总数、用户人数或安全事件情况。

Abstract: Developing autonomous electric wheelchairs capable of long-horizon sidewalk navigation is critical for accessible personal mobility, yet existing approaches either focus on indoor map-based navigation or rely on expensive, complex sensor stacks to achieve full autonomy. In this work, we propose to tackle outdoor sidewalk navigation by leveraging visual navigation foundation models and large-scale navigation datasets, which offer strong generalization using lightweight hardware. To this end, we present ChairNav, a novel framework that adapts a general visual navigation model into a personalized electric wheelchair navigation system using a three-stage data pyramid. To address the scarcity of in-domain data, ChairNav first pre-trains on large-scale cross-embodiment datasets transformed into the wheelchair domain, followed by mid-training on a small number of wheelchair demonstrations to eliminate remaining domain gaps. Finally, a post-training stage refines the deployed model from user interventions to personalize its behavior. We deploy ChairNav on a commercial electric wheelchair equipped with an RGB-D camera and an onboard NVIDIA Jetson compute module. Experimental results validate the effectiveness of each stage in our data pyramid: pre-training reduces lateral ADE by 18%, and post-training increases the mean distance between user interventions from 29.2 m to 57.4 m. Further evaluation on kilometer-scale urban sidewalk routes shows that our system operates autonomously for 93.4% of total driving time, demonstrating its potential for everyday accessible mobility. Demo video and more details are at https://vail.cs.ucla.edu/ChairNav/.

[301] CLARO: Clutter Aware Robot Orchestrator for Open-Vocabulary Grasping using VLM Agents cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Details

Motivation: 家庭、仓库和实验室中的语言指令机器人需在杂乱环境中进行多步规划、执行并根据动态变化重规划，不能只依赖单步目标检测或抓取。

Insight: 长时杂乱操作需要让检测、抓取和推挤技能由统一智能体根据动作历史进行组合与重规划，而非依赖单一预定义抓取管线。摘要未给不同技能消融或真实测试样本数。

Abstract: Robots that follow natural-language instructions unlock a wide range of autonomous applications in households, warehouses, and labs. Real-world environments are diverse and often heavily cluttered, requiring robots to plan over multiple steps, act, and replan as they work toward a goal. We present CLARO (CLutter-Aware Robot Orchestrator), a VLM agent that orchestrates a set of perception and manipulation skills: open-vocabulary object detection, segmentation, 6-DoF grasping, and non-prehensile pushing to locate and retrieve a language-specified target in clutter. CLARO maintains a memory of its past actions to support long-horizon execution, and emits manipulation targets (grasp poses/3D waypoints) allowing transfer across robot arms without task-specific training. We evaluate CLARO against a range of methods on a dynamic simulation environment and standard image-based benchmarks, demonstrating strong generalization across object classes, lighting, and clutter levels. CLARO attains an average success rate of 89.1%, a relative improvement of over 16% on the strongest competing method in high cluttered scenes. We further analyze performance along grounding and grasping axes to characterize where each method succeeds and fails. Finally, we deploy CLARO on a robot arm across diverse cluttered scenes, achieving a success rate of 88.8%, and demonstrating strong sim2real generalizability.

[302] Vision as Proprioception: Estimating Humanoid Robot Pose from Video cs.RO | cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

TL;DR: HumanoidPose 将视觉当作本体感觉，用预训练人体姿态特征与机器人运动学从视频恢复世界坐标全身关节配置；通过合成迁移覆盖 16 种人形形态，并用无标签网络视频自训练提升现实泛化，在三种真实机器人上的关节角误差比各自最佳基线低 18–32%。

Abstract: Estimating a humanoid robot’s internal state from video has a wide range of real-world applications but remains unexplored. During interactions with a robot, its onboard state information may be unavailable due to privacy, ownership, or communication constraints. Meanwhile, online and AI-generated robot videos provide rich sources of data but typically lack corresponding joint configurations, limiting their direct use in robot learning. To address these issues, we present HumanoidPose, a new framework that treats vision as proprioception to recover full-body joint configurations in world space from video alone. Specifically, we combine pretrained human-pose features with robot kinematics in a unified model that predicts each embodiment’s joint configurations. We retarget human motions to sixteen different humanoid embodiments, enabling scalable learning entirely from synthetic data. To improve real-world generalization, we further leverage unlabeled online videos through self-training to develop a 2D robot-pose detector. In our evaluation, HumanoidPose improves joint-angle and joint-position accuracy over the evaluated baselines and reduces joint-angle error by 18-32% relative to the best-performing baseline on each of the three real humanoid platforms. We further show improved global localization and generalization to unseen embodiments. HumanoidPose enables visual understanding of other robots during interaction and extraction of robot motion from online and generated videos.

[303] BiDex-100: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation Across 100+ Simulation Tasks cs.RO | cs.CV | cs.LGPDF

Yong Wang, Kecheng Zheng, Xing Zhu, Chao Xu, Yujun Shen

TL;DR: BiDex-100 是双手灵巧操作仿真基准，包含 106 个覆盖泛化、指令遵循、少量示范、长时任务和记忆的任务；每个任务配受控视觉与空间变化的域外版本，并提供两种形态、8,080 条验证成功的遥操作示范和 625 万帧。

Details

Motivation: 双手高自由度灵巧操作受到越来越多关注，但专为灵巧操作设计的基准较少，导致现有机器人动作模型的能力边界和鲁棒性缺少系统刻画。

Result: BiDex-100 将双手灵巧操作任务划分为五种能力轴：泛化、指令跟随、有限示范、长时任务与记忆，共 106 个仿真任务。每个任务还有通过受控视觉和空间变化构造的域外版本，用于系统测量鲁棒性。基准支持两种机器人形态，提供 8,080 条经成功验证的遥操作示范，共 625 万帧。作者在统一协议下评估七种近期视觉—语言—动作模型，建立各能力、鲁棒性和数据效率的基线。

Insight: 任务能力轴与受控域外变化相结合，可分辨模型是会操作，还是只适应特定外观和空间布局。摘要主要介绍基准与评测资源，没有列出七个模型的具体得分。

Abstract: Bimanual manipulation with dexterous hands has attracted growing attention in research on robotic action models. However, few studies have developed benchmarks specifically tailored for dexterous manipulation, leaving the dexterous manipulation capabilities of existing models insufficiently characterized. In this paper, we present BiDex-100, a simulation benchmark for bimanual dexterous manipulation that combines broad task coverage, multi-dimensional evaluation, and high-DoF hand embodiments. Concretely, the benchmark comprises 106 tasks organized along five capability axes: generalization, instruction following, limited demonstrations, long horizon, and memory. Each task is paired with an out-of-domain variant featuring controlled visual and spatial changes, allowing systematic assessment of robustness. In addition, the benchmark supports two embodiments and provides 8,080 success-validated teleoperated demonstrations, totaling 6.25 million frames. We evaluate seven recent Vision-Language-Action models under a unified protocol, establishing baselines for capability-specific performance, robustness, and data efficiency. The website is available at https://BiDex-100.github.io/BiDex-100/.

[304] InteractAgent: Agentic Human Motion Interaction with Memory-Augmented Reflection cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Tao Zhang, Senhe Zhang, Zeyu Zhang, Yujia Zhang, Dong Gong

TL;DR: InteractAgent 用同一个多模态 LLM 负责长时人—场景交互的计划与评估，以冻结 MotionLLM 执行，并结合逐步观察恢复决策和记忆增强反思迭代细化计划；UniHSI 上较免训练基线提高任务成功并减少穿透。

Details

Motivation: 长时人体—场景交互需要协调空间推理、物理可行性并从累积执行错误中恢复。文本动作模型通常不感知场景且缺少闭环修正；几何条件方法则依赖成对场景—动作训练数据或显式 3D 预处理，难泛化到新布局和开放词汇目标。

Result: InteractAgent 是智能体式多模态 LLM 系统，以同一 MLLM 兼任规划器和评估器，冻结 MotionLLM 作为动作执行器，闭环进行计划、执行、观察和反思。Online Observation 模块逐步决定继续、重做或重规划；Memory-Augmented Reflection 则支持多轮计划改进和自适应停止。UniHSI 实验显示，较免训练基线，InteractAgent 提高任务成功率并降低人体与场景穿透。

Insight: 将规划、执行后的观察和记忆反思放进闭环，有助于在长时交互中修正累积误差，而无需针对新场景动作数据训练。摘要未给出任务成功和穿透的具体数值，无法量化改进幅度。

Abstract: Long-horizon human-scene interaction requires coordinated spatial reasoning, physical feasibility, and the ability to recover from compounding execution errors. Text-driven motion models are largely scene-agnostic and lack closed-loop correction, while geometry-conditioned approaches depend on paired scene-motion training or explicit 3D preprocessing that limits generalization to novel layouts and open-vocabulary goals. We present InteractAgent, an agentic multimodal LLM system for long-horizon human-scene interaction that plans, executes, observes, and reflects in a closed loop, using a single MLLM as both planner and evaluator and a frozen MotionLLM as the executor. InteractAgent integrates Online Observation for step-wise recovery decisions (continue/redo/replan) and Memory-Augmented Reflection for multi-round plan refinement with adaptive stopping. On UniHSI, InteractAgent improves task success and reduces penetration compared with training-free baselines. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/InteractAgent.

[305] Vision-Language-Delta-Action: Learning Compact Deltas as Actionable Transition Interfaces for Robotic Manipulation cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Lingsen Zhang, Wei Li, Jie He, Henghua Zhang, Kai Mo

TL;DR: VLDA 把机器人操作从直接学习视觉到动作映射，改为预测紧凑的可操作状态变化 Delta，并用局部转移过滤器、全局转移锚点及 Delta 驱动动作细化连接语义理解与动作生成；实验报告长时一致性、鲁棒性和泛化能力改善。

Details

Motivation: 机器人操作的核心是实现任务指定的物理状态变化，而不是单纯从观察生成动作。直接视觉—语言—动作映射要跨越语义理解与动作执行鸿沟；世界动作模型虽可预测未来，却可能把容量耗在静态外观和与动作无关的变化上。

Result: Vision-Language-Delta-Action（VLDA）将完整未来状态预测改为紧凑的可操作转移建模，以 Delta 表示潜在世界状态变化，作为视觉语言理解和动作生成的接口。Local Transition Filter 捕捉与操作相关的变化并抑制静态重建偏差；Global Transition Anchor 提供粗粒度未来约束以维持变化方向。Delta-Driven Action Refinement 再将 Delta 对齐到动作空间，作为结构化起点引导动作去噪。该框架在 LoongForge 中实现两阶段统一优化。实验显示，VLDA 提升长时一致性、鲁棒性和泛化能力。

Insight: 建模任务相关状态差分可能比重建完整未来更节省容量，并为动作生成提供中间接口。摘要未给出基准名称、定量提升或 Delta 表示误差。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation is not merely observation-to-action generation, but the realization of task-specified state changes in the physical world. Existing vision-language-action (VLA) methods directly learn observation-to-action mappings, imposing a substantial learning burden due to the gap between semantic understanding and action execution. Although world-action models (WAMs) improve control through future prediction, modeling complete future states wastes capacity on static appearance and action-irrelevant changes. We propose Vision-Language-Delta-Action (VLDA), a paradigm that reformulates full future prediction as compact actionable transition modeling. Its core is a compact Delta variable that captures latent world-state changes, serving as an interface between vision-language understanding and action generation. VLDA learns Delta through a unified objective composed of the Local Transition Filter (LT-Filter) and Global Transition Anchor (GT-Anchor). LT-Filter captures task-relevant manipulation-centric changes while suppressing static reconstruction biases. GT-Anchor provides coarse future-level regularization to preserve the overall direction of state changes. Delta-Driven Action Refinement (DDAR) further grounds Delta in the action manifold and injects it as a structured seed to guide action denoising. We implement VLDA within LoongForge, an open-source training framework for large-scale foundation and embodied models, using its modular and distributed infrastructure for unified two-stage optimization. Experiments show that VLDA improves long-horizon consistency, robustness, and generalization, validating actionable Delta as an alternative to direct action prediction and full future-state modeling.

[306] Where is Physical RSI capability from? An Observational Scaling Law of LLM-as-policy cs.RO | cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

Zekai Li, Jiayi Yu, Jinlu Zhang, Luyang Niu, Zekun Qi

TL;DR: PhysRSI-eval 用首次表现、效率、成功、预算和失败后改进五轴衡量视觉语言模型的物理递归自我改进，并在 18 项操作任务与固定交互预算下评估；分析发现移除历史会降低后期成功，冻结工作区仍能帮助未见布局，提示场景适配和可复用经验可并存。

Details

Motivation: 物理环境中的递归自我改进需要模型在动作尝试后根据反馈调整策略，但现有公开基准平均成绩难区分首次能力、交互效率和失败后学习速度。

Result: 论文提出 PhysRSI-eval，以首次尝试表现、效率、成功、预算消耗和从失败中改进五个维度量化物理 RSI，在固定交互预算下评估多个 VLM 的 18 项操作任务。不同模型公共基准平均接近时，五轴指标仍能显示差异，也表明高平均分不保证早期或高效进步。作者从两个角度做观察性缩放分析：用公开能力预测 VLM 智能体相对表现，以及用早期物理反馈预测后续改进。工作区干预发现，删除历史会降低后期成功；冻结工作区仍有助于未见布局；三个跨任务案例实现更早成功。结果提示场景特定适配与可复用经验可以共存。

Insight: 衡量物理环境自我改进不能只看最终成功率，还要记录首次能力、交互预算和失败后学习；历史与场景信息既可能影响局部适配，也可能支持跨任务复用。摘要未提供缩放规律数值或各 VLM 表现排名。

Abstract: In this paper, we systematically investigate the mechanisms, scaling behavior, and generalization of physical Recursive self-improvement. We introduce PhysRSI-eval to quantify physical RSI through a five-axis metric: First-Attempt Performance, Efficiency, Success, Budget and Improvement from failure. Different VLMs are evaluated on 18 manipulation tasks under a fixed interaction budget. The analysis of experimental results motivates the Physical Barrel Hypothesis: different capabilities may constrain different parts of improvement. The five-axis metrics also distinguish systems with close public benchmark averages and show that high scores need not come with early or efficient gains. We study observational scaling from two perspectives: predicting the relative performance of VLM agents from their public capabilities, and forecasting later progress from early physical feedback. Together, these analyses ask how quickly and how far an agent can improve. Moreover, we conduct workspace interventions and then analyze what improvement leaves behind. Removing history reduces late-round success, frozen workspaces remain useful on unseen layouts, and three cross-task cases achieve success earlier. The results suggest that scene-specific adaptation and reusable experience can coexist.

[307] Long Listening Thoughts: Eliciting Open Auditory Reasoning with Deliberative Perception and Cognitive Refinement cs.SD | cs.AI | cs.CL | eess.ASPDF

Jaeyeon Kim, Chao-Han Huck Yang, Luoyi Zhang, Chan-Jan Hsu, Fernando Ruiloba Portilla

TL;DR: LLT 构建结合细致听觉感知与显式认知行为的长音频推理训练数据：合成 160 万条推理轨迹并用于 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 的 SFT+DPO，在 MMAU Test-mini、MMAR 和 MMSU 上分别将准确率从 71.5 提至 78.2、56.7 提至 63.7、60.6 提至 66.0。

Details

Motivation: 大型音频语言模型在音频理解和推理基准上的主要瓶颈往往是感知错误，但现有后训练数据中的音频描述类型有限，推理过程也较少显式包含核验、回溯等认知行为。论文希望同时提升音频证据覆盖和长链推理质量。

Result: Long Listening Thoughts（LLT）通过四阶段流程构建数据：生成覆盖语义、声学和时间信息的多角度密集描述；提出更具挑战的问题；合成错误推理轨迹；再用思路续写策略把短轨迹扩展成长轨迹，诱发核验和回溯等行为。作者合成 160 万条推理轨迹，并以先监督微调、后直接偏好优化训练 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B。MMAU Test-mini 准确率从 71.5 提至 78.2，MMAR 从 56.7 提至 63.7，MMSU 从 60.6 提至 66.0。

Insight: 音频推理训练数据需要明确覆盖细粒度听觉线索和可检查的思维行为，而不只是增加音频描述样本。结果来自所列模型与三个基准，摘要未拆分四阶段组件的独立贡献。

Abstract: We introduce Long Listening Thoughts (LLT), a framework for constructing post-training datasets that improves audio reasoning by pairing deliberate perceptual grounding with explicit cognitive behaviors. On audio understanding and reasoning benchmarks, large audio-language models (LALMs) are limited primarily by perceptual errors, yet existing post-training datasets rely on audio descriptions of limited diversity. Through a four-stage pipeline, LLT (1) builds multi-aspect dense audio descriptions spanning semantic, acoustic, and temporal information, (2) generates more challenging questions, (3) synthesizes incorrect reasoning traces, and (4) extends short reasoning traces into long ones via a thought-continuation strategy that elicits cognitive behaviors such as verification and backtracking. Using LLT, we synthesize 1.6M reasoning traces and train Qwen2.5-Omni-7B with a two-stage pipeline of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by direct preference optimization (DPO). This improves accuracy on MMAU Test-mini (71.5 to 78.2), MMAR (56.7 to 63.7), and MMSU (60.6 to 66.0).

[308] AudioScorer: Learning Question-Aware Token Relevance for Large Audio Language Models cs.SD | cs.CL | eess.ASPDF

Marwan Farag, Bin Yang

TL;DR: AudioScorer 根据用户问题预测大型音频语言模型的音频 token 相关性，以冻结 LALM 的答案梯度显著性排序作为蒸馏监督，并结合答案监督训练；仅保留 10% token 时，在 10 个语义与声学任务中的 7 个达到最佳或并列最佳。

Details

Motivation: 大型音频语言模型需要处理语音、环境声、音乐等密集音频 token 序列，长音频计算成本高。现有剪枝方法依赖注意力、表示相似度或时间采样等启发式，没有直接学习哪些 token 对当前问题最有用。

Result: AudioScorer 是轻量问题条件打分模型，根据用户问题为音频 token 评分。训练时蒸馏冻结 LALM 对答案的梯度显著性排序，并加入下游答案监督。与其他 token 剪枝方法比较，在仅保留 10% token 时，AudioScorer 在 10 个语义和声学任务中的 7 个取得最佳或并列最佳，包括语音识别、情绪识别和音频场景分类。

Insight: 音频 token 的价值依赖当前问题，问题条件的相关性排序比固定时间采样或通用注意力分数更适合压缩长音频输入。摘要未报告其余三项任务的差距、编码器速度或显存节省。

Abstract: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) reason over speech, environmental sounds, music, and other acoustic information. However, their audio encoders produce dense token sequences that make long-form audio costly to process. Existing audio pruning methods reduce this cost using heuristics such as attention, representation similarity, or temporal sampling, but do not explicitly learn which tokens are most useful for a given question. We propose AudioScorer, a lightweight model that scores audio tokens according to the user question. It is trained by distilling the ranking of audio tokens under the frozen LALM’s answer-gradient saliency, together with downstream answer supervision. Compared with other pruning methods, AudioScorer achieves the best or tied-best result at 10% token retention on 7 of 10 semantic and acoustic tasks, including speech recognition, emotion recognition, and audio-scene classification.

[309] Label Authority in Speech Emotion Recognition: Intended and Perceived Ground Truth in Emozionalmente cs.SD | cs.CL | eess.ASPDF

Marco Giordano, Stefano Giacomelli, Claudia Rinaldi, Fabio Graziosi

TL;DR: 在意大利 Emozionalmente 语料上比较三种语音情绪标签权威后，作者发现识别表演者表达的情绪比预测听众多数票容易；完整听众投票分布虽不明显改变模型硬分类，却能更好保留模糊语音中的感知不确定性。

Details

Motivation: 语音情绪识别常将真值当作单一类别，但表演者意图表达的情绪与听众实际听到的情绪是同一录音的不同方面。若标签权威不明确，模型之间的性能比较可能把任务定义差异误认为识别能力差异。

Result: 研究使用 Emozionalmente 意大利表演语音语料，每段录音均有诱发的表演情绪标签和五位听众判断；以冻结 XLS-R、HuBERT 和 WavLM 表征及匹配探针，比较表达条件、听众硬多数票和完整投票分布。三种表征得到一致结论：恢复表演情绪比预测打破平票后的听众多数类别容易，但二者是不同问题，不能据此断言一般语音情绪识别能力下降。听众一致性越弱，多数票硬标签越脆弱。使用完整投票分布训练不会明显改变硬分类胜出类别，却会使概率分配更贴近听众选择的备选情绪，尤其对模糊片段如此。

Insight: 表达标签说明说话者如何表演，听众多数票提供单类操作决策，投票分布保留感知不确定性，三者不能互相替代。面向用户的评测应说明预测哪种权威并保留聚合和一致性信息。

Abstract: Ground truth in Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) is often presented as a single categorical fact, yet an acted emotion and the emotion heard by listeners describe different aspects of the same recording. We examine this distinction in Emozionalmente, an acted Italian corpus that provides both an elicited production label and five listener judgements for every clip. Using frozen XLS-R, HuBERT, and WavLM representations with matched probes, we compare three label authorities: the expressed condition, the listeners’ hard plurality, and their complete vote distribution. The results tell a consistent story. Recovering the expressed condition is easier than predicting a tie-broken listener plurality, but that gap compares two different questions rather than revealing a general loss of SER ability. As listener agreement weakens, the plurality becomes an increasingly brittle hard target. Training on the full vote distribution does not substantially change which class wins the model’s hard decision, but it produces probability assignments that more closely follow the alternatives selected by listeners, especially for ambiguous clips. No authority therefore replaces the others. Expressed labels describe how speech was produced, pluralities provide an operational single-class decision, and vote distributions preserve perceptual uncertainty. For human-facing Internet of Sounds applications, evaluations should state which authority is being predicted, retain its aggregation rule and agreement information, and use distributional scores when disagreement is part of the target.
