[310] Severity-Channel Conditioning: An Injection-Level Study for Consumer-Device Deblurring eess.IV | cs.AI | cs.CV | cs.LG | cs.MMPDF

Abdullah Al Shafi, Kazi Saeed Alam, Sumaiya Rahim Suma, Sk. Imran Hossain

TL;DR: 这项消费者设备去模糊研究比较四种严重程度信息注入方式；在允许推理时使用部分由配对清晰目标导出的 oracle 严重程度描述符的诊断设置中，输入拼接使 PSNR 从 31.23 提至 31.30 dB，但作者明确指出结果不证明注入位置是唯一原因，也不构成可靠部署优势。

Details

Motivation: 运动去模糊模型从专业相机迁移到手机图像时准确率下降。论文研究从 iPhoneBlur 配对数据导出的模糊严重程度描述符是否能改善适配，并在相同更新预算下比较输入拼接、全局元数据调制、空间特征调制和分层对比输出目标。

Result: 实验在同一个域适配潜扩散基线上微调所有方案，并纳入无条件频谱损失控制。主要实验是 oracle 诊断：推理时提供部分基于配对清晰目标得到的严重程度信息。被测模型对中，拼接严重程度图将整体 PSNR 从 31.23 提至 31.30 dB；特征调制、对比目标和频谱损失控制均未超过基线。增益在 87.2% 测试图像及 15 个留出源视频中的 14 个为正，但视频级结果只描述该检查点对，不证明重训鲁棒性；报告三个训练种子。输入级增益也在一个 Transformer 骨干上出现。一次探索实验中，推理时将该通道置零仍保留大部分 PSNR 增益，但 SSIM 降至基线以下；归一化步长诊断不支持预期的梯度更大解释。

Insight: 结果支持被测配置中输入级严重程度通道带来有限 PSNR 改善，但 oracle 目标信息、指标差异和检查点范围限制了部署结论；作者明确表示这些结果不能证明注入位置是唯一原因、存在空间局部机制或有可靠部署优势。

Abstract: Motion-deblurring models lose substantial accuracy when transferred from professional cameras to smartphone-derived imagery. This paper studies whether a severity descriptor, partly derived from the paired sharp target, helps adaptation on the iPhoneBlur consumer-device benchmark. Under a shared update budget, input concatenation of a severity map is compared with global feature modulation by capture metadata, spatial feature modulation by the severity map, and a tier-contrastive output objective, together with an unconditioned spectral-loss control, all fine-tuned from the same domain-adapted latent-diffusion baseline. The primary experiment is an oracle diagnostic: target-derived information is supplied at inference. For the evaluated model pair, input concatenation improves overall peak signal-to-noise ratio from 31.23 to 31.30 dB, whereas feature modulation, the contrastive objective, and the spectral-loss control do not exceed the baseline. The gain is positive on 87.2% of test images and on 14 of 15 held-out source videos; this video-level analysis describes the evaluated checkpoint pair and does not establish robustness to retraining, and three training seeds are reported separately. The input-level gain recurs on a transformer backbone. In one exploratory run, zeroing the channel at inference retains most of the gain in peak signal-to-noise ratio but lowers structural similarity below the baseline. A normalized-step diagnostic does not support the expected larger-gradient explanation. The results characterize the evaluated configurations and do not establish injection location as the sole cause, a spatial-locality mechanism, or a reliable deployment advantage.

[311] Progressive multi-scale tumor-state memory for incomplete multimodal brain tumor segmentation eess.IV | cs.CVPDF

Milad Rostamian, Mohammadreza Mohammadi, Mohsen Soryani

TL;DR: PMTM 在编码器各阶段维护当前受试者的肿瘤状态记忆，将可用 MRI 序列的空间特征汇聚为有序证据并门控融合到状态，再用于引导后续尺度融合；在 BraTS2018、2020、2023 GLI 的全部 15 种非空序列子集上，平均 Dice 分别为 75.31%、77.54% 和 80.47%。

Details

Motivation: 脑肿瘤分割常依赖互补 MRI 序列，但实际中某些序列可能不可用，不同肿瘤区域可用的信息也随缺失模态改变。仅支持多种输入组合的融合结构，并未明确说明肿瘤证据如何跨尺度保留并更新。

Result: Progressive Multi-scale Tumor-state Memory（PMTM）面向 T1ce、T1、FLAIR、T2 任意非空子集分割。在每个编码阶段，分配图将空间特征汇聚为各可用模态的有序证据向量，跨模态取均值后由学习门控与上一阶段状态合并；更新状态随后引导该阶段残差融合，并传递给下一阶段。模态 token 混合器还在每一阶段建模可用模态间交互，所有阶段的分配图均接受语义监督。三组 BraTS 数据集的 15 种模态子集上，平均 Dice 分别为 75.31%、77.54%、80.47%，均高于作者实验中 RobustSeg、RFNet 和 mmFormer。BraTS2020 另进行组件消融和内部状态分析。

Insight: 显式跨阶段保存和更新受试者级肿瘤证据，可使后续多尺度融合利用前阶段信息，而不仅仅堆叠模态特征。摘要未列各肿瘤区域分数或不同缺失模式的逐项结果。

Abstract: Brain tumor segmentation uses complementary magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) sequences, but some sequences may be unavailable in practice. Their absence changes the information available for segmenting different tumor regions. Fusion methods can support different input subsets. However, fusion at several scales does not by itself specify how tumor evidence is retained and updated to guide fusion at later stages. We propose a progressive multi-scale tumor-state memory network (PMTM) for segmentation from any non-empty subset of T1ce, T1, FLAIR, and T2. PMTM maintains a compact state for the current subject across the encoder stages. At each stage, we use assignment maps to pool spatial features into ordered evidence vectors for each available modality. We average these vectors across the available modalities, and a learned gate combines this evidence with the previous state. The up- dated state guides residual fusion at that stage and is used in the state update at the next stage. A modality-token mixer also models interactions among the available modalities at each stage. We apply semantic supervision to the assignment maps at all four stages. We evaluate PMTM on BraTS2018, BraTS2020, and BraTS2023 GLI across all 15 non-empty modality subsets. Averaged over the three tumor regions and the 15 subsets, PMTM achieves Dice scores of 75.31%, 77.54%, and 80.47% on BraTS2018, BraTS2020, and BraTS2023 GLI, respectively. These scores are higher than those of RobustSeg, RFNet, and mmFormer in our experiments on each dataset. Component ablations and internal state analysis are performed on BraTS2020.

[312] Teacher Supervision, Fixed Representations and Calibration: Exact Risk Calculations for Candidate-Scoring Decision Models stat.ML | cs.CL | cs.LG | q-fin.RMPDF

Agus Sudjianto, Denis Burakov

TL;DR: 理论分析表明，学生会继承软标签教师偏差，增加学生数据或匹配温度校准都不能自动纠正错误方向；在 231,521 条 CFPB 投诉上，结果标签训练的决策成本比逻辑教师概率训练低 8%，说明候选评分模型的概率需与真实结果核验。

Details

Motivation: 候选评分决策模型对给定选项输出概率分布。已有系统采用大模型软标签、冻结预训练骨干和温度校准，但这些训练环节究竟决定概率代表什么，以及它们何时降低风险或隐藏偏差，需要精确分析。

Result: 作者在高斯代理模型中精确计算有限样本风险：教师软标签训练的学生会继承教师偏差，更多学生数据无法消除，师生一致也不能证明无偏；固定表示仅在明确样本量阈值以下降低风险；probit 模型的精确再校准可用温度缩放表达，只有教师系数方向正确时才能消除全部额外风险，否则留下常规校准诊断未发现的残差。Luce 选择公理下，候选分数对事件细分保持一致，当且仅当通过 log-sum-exp 聚合。CFPB 的 231,521 条信用卡投诉中，以是否获得金钱补偿为结果：逻辑教师概率训练的学生达到教师决策成本，结果标签训练则比教师低 8%；30B 模型零样本结果即使再校准仍差于教师，且候选分数偏离一致性条件 17.5 decibans。

Insight: 冻结表示可以节省标注，校准可修正概率尺度，但二者都不能消除教师偏差；概率是否可信需要用实际结果检验。实际投诉数据的结论对应特定决策任务，摘要未说明其他业务场景的决策成本。

Abstract: Candidate-scoring decision models return a probability distribution over a presented set of answers. Public documentation of one such system, Jev, and of an open counterpart, JevAny, describes three training ingredients that determine what these probabilities estimate: soft targets from larger models, a frozen pretrained backbone and temperature calibration. We analyze each ingredient in Gaussian surrogates where the finite-sample risk can be computed exactly. A student trained on teacher targets inherits the teacher’s bias, which more student data does not remove and agreement with the teacher does not reveal. A fixed representation lowers the risk only below an explicit sample-size threshold. In a probit model the exact recalibration map is a temperature scaling, which removes all excess risk only when the teacher’s coefficient has the correct direction and otherwise leaves a residual that calibration diagnostics do not detect. Under Luce’s choice axiom, candidate scores are coherent across refinements of an event if and only if they aggregate by log-sum-exp. On 231,521 credit card complaints from the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, where the decision is whether a complaint ends in monetary relief, a student trained on a logistic teacher’s probabilities ends at the teacher’s decision cost while a student trained on outcomes goes 8% below it, a 30B model read zero-shot remains worse than the teacher after recalibration, and that model departs from the coherence condition by 17.5 decibans. Pretrained representations reduce the labeled data required and calibration corrects the scale of the probabilities, but neither corrects a biased teacher, so the probabilities have to be checked against realized outcomes.
